news.Title: 權證代號怎麼看？「購、售、牛、熊」代表什麼？一文看帶你從名稱快速看懂標的與類型！
news.Content:
當投資人打開券商 App 搜尋權證時，螢幕上總會跳出一長串像「密碼」一樣的名字，比如「台積電元大3A購01」或是「鴻海凱基39售02」等等。對剛接觸權證的新手來說，這些由中文、數字與字母組成的字串常讓人一頭霧水。但其實 發行券商早已把這檔商品最重要的履約條件與類型寫在名稱裡 。只要掌握組合邏輯，三秒鐘就能看懂眼前這檔商品到底是看漲還是看跌。

權證名稱看起來複雜許多。但其實這並非隨機命名，而是依據台灣證券交易所規定的標準格式。發行券商把 標的股票、發行機構以及獲利方向 等關鍵資訊，全數打包在這張「商品身分證」裡。只要學會拆解文字結構，就能輕鬆讀懂其中的含義，並快速掌握這檔權證的性質。

拆解權證名稱，四個區塊讀懂商品身分

權證的中文名稱結構非常固定，通常由 「標的股票」、「發行券商」、「發行序列」以及「權證類型」 四大元素依序組合而成。

以「台積電元大3A購01」為例：

最前面的「台積電」代表這檔 權證連結的標的股票 ，它的漲跌將直接影響權證的價值；緊接著的「元大」則是 負責發行並提供買賣報價的證券商 ；中間的「3A」與「01」屬於 券商內部的發行序列與編號 ，用來區分同一家券商對同一檔股票發行的不同批次權證；而最後面的字尾 「購」，則是決定獲利方向的核心關鍵 。只要照著這個順序閱讀，就能瞬間明白這是一檔由元大證券發行、連結台積電的認購權證。

「購、售、牛、熊」是什麼？從字尾秒懂獲利方向

名稱最後面的關鍵字，直接決定了投資人對未來行情的預判。在台灣市場中，最常見的四大類型分別是「購」、「售」、「牛」與「熊」。

「購」，指的是「認購權證」，代表你看好未來的行情 。只要標的股票上漲，這檔權證的價格通常就會跟著水漲船高。相反地， 字尾如果是「售」，則是「認售權證」，代表看空行情 。當標的股票下跌時，認售權證的價格反而會上漲，適合用來做下跌行情的避險或反向操作。

至於經常讓人搞不清楚的 「牛」與「熊」，其實是「牛熊證」的簡稱 ，屬於結構比較特別的權證。簡而言之， 牛證與認購權證一樣是看多，熊證則與認售權證一樣是看空 。這類商品的特色在於價格變化與標的股票非常貼近，且多設定了「回收價」機制。一旦股票價格在到期前不幸觸及這個設定的界線，商品就會強制提前結算下市，概念就像是自帶自動停損機制的進階版權證。

六碼數字藏玄機，代號字尾也有辨識標準

除了看懂中文全名，下單介面上的六碼數字代號，同樣遵循著標準化的識別規則。

在台股交易系統中，一般連結國內股票的認購權證，代號通常是由六位純數字組成，常見開頭為 03 到 08 等區段。如果是認售權證，為了方便投資人快速區隔， 六碼代號的最後一位通常會補上英文字母「P」（代表 Put）。若是看到代號結尾帶有「C」（代表 Call）或「B」等字母，則多半屬於牛熊證系列 。這種編碼原則，讓交易者就算只看數字代號，也能在第一時間確認買進的是看漲還是看跌的工具。

看懂權證的名稱與代號，是踏入權證交易最基礎也最重要的一步。許多新手在盤中行情急漲急跌時慌忙下單，常因為沒看清名稱字尾的「購」與「售」，把看多的認購權證買成了看空的認售權證，白白賠掉本金。下次在下單軟體搜尋時，不妨花三秒鐘拆解名稱，確認標的、發行券商與類型完全符合預期後再出單，就能有效避免買錯商品低級錯誤發生。

（核稿編輯：劉凱銘）

news.Title: 權證的履約價、到期日、價內價外是什麼？用簡單範例一次看懂核心名詞
news.Content:
「點開券商 App 看到一堆履約價、價內價外 15%、到期日…到底該怎麼選？」「看中某一檔台積電權證，萬一股票漲了但權證沒漲，是不是選錯履約價了？」權證雖然具備「低門檻、高槓桿」的優勢，但若搞不懂畫面上的參數與核心名詞，容易一不小心就買到快要失效的商品。

履約價、到期日是什麼？決定權證價值的 3 大核心要素

打開券商的權證搜尋頁面，會看到一連串技術參數，其中最基本的 3 個核心要素包含：

標的物（母股）： 權證背後對應的股票，例如台積電、鴻海或聯發科。

履約價： 雙方約定在未來用來買進或賣出股票的 「指定價格」 。例如買進台積電認購權證、履約價設為 1,100 元，代表不論未來台積電漲到 1,200 元還是 1,500 元，你都有權利以 1,100 元的價格買進。

到期日與存續期間： 權證是有「壽命」的，通常發行時的存續期間為 6 個月（約 180 天）左右。一旦到了到期日，權證就會進行現金結算並正式失效。

什麼是「價內、價平、價外」？

「價內（In-the-money）、價平（At-the-money）、價外（Out-of-the-money）」是用來描述股票現價 與 權證履約價 之間的差距，它直接決定了權證當下有沒有「實質履約價值」：

以認購權證為例：

價內（In-the-money）： 股票現價 > 履約價 。代表現在履約就能立刻賺到價差，權證具有「真實內含價值」。

價平（At-the-money）： 股票現價 = 履約價 。代表股票價格剛好達到約定履約價。

價外（Out-of-the-money）： 股票現價 < 履約價 。代表現在履約會虧錢，權證目前沒有內含價值，只剩下「期待到期前會漲突破履約價」的時間價值。

權證怎麼獲利與結算？

假設你看好台積電短期內會大幅噴發，花錢買進了某檔台積電認購權證：

台積電現股價格： 1,000 元

權證履約價格： 1,100 元（代表你擁有用 1,100 元買台積電的權利）

行使比例： 0.01（代表 1 股權證等於 0.01 股台積電股票的權利）

你買進的權證價格： 每股 1.5 元（一張即 1,500 元）

你購買的數量： 10 張

總本金（權利金） = 15,000 元

以下是這檔權證到了 到期日 時，三種不同的結算獲利情況：

情況一：台積電漲到 1,200 元（價內）

計算現股價差：1,200 - 1,100 = 100元

乘以行使比例（換算每股權證價值）：100 x 0.01 = 1 元（代表你手上的權證此時每股價值 1 元）

計算你能拿回的結算現金：1 元 x 10,000 股 = 10,000 元

最終總損益：你拿回了 10,000 元，但因為一開始付了 15,000 元的本金，所以實質上反而虧損：10,000 - 15,000 = -5,000 元。

這說明了就算現股漲過履約價， 如果漲幅不夠補平買進時付出的權利金成本，結算仍可能虧損 。

情況二：台積電只漲到 1,050 元（價外）

計算現股價差：1,050 - 1,100 = -50 元（代表沒有履約價值）

最終總損益：系統判定此權證自動失效。你的股票庫存裡這檔權證會直接消失。你 拿不回任何一毛錢 ，最慘的狀況就是損失當初投入的 15,000 元本金 ，但不用補繳任何保證金。

情況三：台積電在「到期前」漲到 1,150 元（到期日前賣出）

你在買進後的第 5 天，台積電突然現股飆漲到 1,150 元 。這時候因為距離到期日還很久，這檔權證在證券市場上的 市價已經從 1.5 元飆漲到 3.5 元 。

你決定不等時間到，直接在盤中把 10 張權證 賣回給券商 ：

賣出總金額：3.5元 x 10,000 股 = 35,000 元

最終總損益：35,000（賣出金額） - 15,000（初始本金） = 20,000 元。

這就是權證最標準的獲利結算方式： 看對方向、在到期前趕快賣掉賺差價 ，這樣才能把「內含價值」和還沒扣完的「時間價值」一起變現。

價內外差、存續期長短有影響？挑選權證3指南

搞懂了權證的名詞與風險後，新手進場時請務必牢記以下 3 個法則：

挑選「價平附近」且「存續期間長」的權證： 新手建議選擇履約價在現價 價外 5% 至 價內 15% 之間、且剩餘到期天數 > 90 天 的權證。這類標的敏感度適中，且時間價值流失的速度較慢。

避開「深度價外」與「快到期」商品： 深度價外（如價外 20% 以上）或剩餘天數少於 30 天的權證雖然單價極便宜（幾百塊就能買一張），但歸零機率極高，容易買到俗稱的「歸零膏」。

嚴格執行短線停損： 權證適合順勢突破的波段操作（持有 1 至 5 天）。一旦現股走勢不如預期，跌破停損線（如虧損 15%~20%）必須果斷出場，切記 絕不加碼攤平、絕不長期死抱 。

認清權證「高槓桿、有壽命」的本質，搞懂履約價與價內外的連動關係，才能讓權證成為你小資金參與大行情的利器，而不是資金歸零的陷阱。

（核稿編輯：劉凱銘）

news.Title: 韓股10月慘陷地獄！單月狂崩23％直逼股災低點 專家揭下一步
news.Content:
Meta雖大幅上調AI資本支出，但自由現金流首度轉負，引發市場對於科技巨頭能否靠自身資金支撐龐大AI投資的疑慮。費城半導體指數周四（22日）重挫近7%，連帶引發亞洲股市今（23）日同步大跳水，日韓股市早盤均重挫並逼近7月股災低點，其中韓股一度狂跌逾4%，隨後在記憶體大廠SK海力士股價翻紅帶動下，跌幅才明顯收斂；韓股從上半年的全球AI飆股領頭羊，一路重挫為10月表現墊底的全球主要股市。

Meta燒錢引爆美股殺盤

這波全球股市拋售潮的導火線來自Meta發布的最新財報。儘管Meta第三季業績超出預期，但公司同時宣布將發行無投票權新股籌集資金，並將全年資本支出下限上調至1350億美元，第三季自由現金流更是出現上市以來首次負數，呈現負21.2億美元。市場對其營運前景感到疑慮，信用市場恐慌情緒升溫，Meta五年期信用違約交換溢價升至歷史新高。

消息一出重創美股科技股，周四（22日）那斯達克指數重挫2.6%創下6月以來最大單日跌幅，費城半導體指數暴跌6.72%；在指標股方面，輝達大跌4.4%、AMD血洗8.10%、Meta崩跌6.98%、美光狂瀉6.26%，SK海力士ADR也慘跌8.07%。

Solidigm上市喊卡 韓國市場消化恐慌賣壓

受市場情緒影響，SK海力士宣布終止旗下快閃記憶體子公司Solidigm赴美上市及Pre-IPO程序，主因股東強烈反對，以及韓國主管機關疑慮重複上市恐損及少數股東權益。

Kiwoom Securities研究員Han Ji-young指出，喊卡上市案可在一定程度上改善半導體類股投資氣氛。她表示，Meta利空先前已部分反映，加上市場呈現超賣，早盤恐慌賣壓消化後，盤中跌幅可望逐步收斂。

南韓未來資產證券（Mirae Asset Securities）執行董事Seo Sang-young則分析，韓國市場多已消化AI投資焦慮與外資籌碼壓力，美股重挫的衝擊預期將減弱，但這並不代表趨勢反轉，後續大盤仍將維持高度波動。

觀察近期走勢韓國KOSPI指數近一個月跌跌不休，波段跌幅已近24%，今日盤中探至5305點，持續逼近7月29日股災時創下的5262點低點，從上半年領跑全球的AI贏家淪為10月表現最差的全球主要股市；日經指數近一個月也修正7.9%，今日回測至61462點，與7月的60448點低點相去不遠。

news.Title: Jay Goldberg：「英特爾+馬斯克」組合對台積電構成的威脅  可能大於Terafab單打獨鬥
news.Content:
Seaport Research Partners資深半導體分析師Jay Goldberg最新指出，馬斯克對台積電造成威脅之處，不一定是他自己硬要造先進晶片，而是「英特爾進場幫馬斯克蓋Terafab」，這會把單挑馬斯克，變成對抗「英特爾＋馬斯克」。

這位半導體節目《The Circuit》共同主持人接受《Benzinga》 專訪時說：「我如果是台積電，我不會擔心得跟 Elon 打一架，我擔心的是得擋住英特爾加馬斯克，因為光是英特爾就讓我夠擔心了。」

Goldberg 認為，英特爾的製造實力能讓馬斯克的Terafab更快具備競爭力；但英特爾在Terafab裡到底扮演什麼角色，目前仍不清楚。

今年4月，馬斯克曾稱Terafab規劃採用英特爾下一代14A製程。Goldberg還說，英特爾「人才底子非常厚」，若由執行長陳立武（主導製造端，專案速度有機會加快。

但問題在於馬斯克願不願意讓出主控權，Goldberg點出馬斯克堅持IP要握在自己手上，這與英特爾傳統代工邏輯未必相容。

他還說，「台積電與英特爾之間一場非常真實的較量正在拉開」，並坦言一年前他還沒料到會出現這種對抗格局。

被問到Terafab是否會演成「馬斯克對上台積電」的決戰，Goldberg則說：「這個劇本預設了比我目前願意給他的更高成功率」。

今年4月，台積電董事長魏哲家曾回應稱英特爾是強勁對手，但晶圓製造「沒有捷徑」。

英特爾這邊誘因很明確且過去曾說，若拿不到重量級外部客戶，14A技術恐不會推到高產能，最新季報則確認會續推開發。馬斯克的Terafab正好能成為14A關鍵出海口，幫英特爾在重建代工業務時扳回一城。

不過，Goldberg 也提醒英特爾若把命壓在馬斯克長期承諾上是有風險的。「如果我是英特爾，我會擔心一件事，兩年後馬斯克會不會就膩了？」

馬斯克10月初表示，特斯拉與SpaceX會自己建廠與營運，台積電則僅傳出可能承租部分德州廠區，不涉及營運。對此Goldberg 直接吐槽說：「這到底是正經蓋晶圓廠，還是變成英特爾的房地產交易？」

Goldberg先前預估，Terafab 2028年才有機會跑起來，但具商業規模的量產可能拖到2030年。

馬斯克週三(21日)在財報會議上表示，Terafab最終造價可能超過1000億美元，特斯拉、SpaceX 還在分攤出資比例，此前一天他更透露兩家公司已成立特別委員會，評估可能合併。目前，Polymarket 賭盤給出「2027年底前正式宣布合併」約70%機率。

若Terafab真的做成，Goldberg點名最大輸家是台積電，英特爾則如同籃球比賽中的「jump ball(跳球)」，結果可能「非常好」，也可能「非常糟」。他總結道：「可行、野心大、做得到，但主要限制會是資金分配，還有他本人的注意力。」

news.Title: Not IonQ. Not D-Wave. This Quantum Stock Could Be 2027's Surprise Winner.
news.Content: While quantum computing holds significant promise as a transformative technology that could improve pharmaceutical discovery, materials science, and artificial intelligence (AI), many quantum computing stocks have failed to deliver lately. Take IonQ (NYSE: IONQ) and D-Wave (NASDAQ: QBTS), for example. Their share prices are down 29% and 54% year to date, respectively, despite the companies being widely considered among the top in quantum computing. Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could ...

news.Title: 二次暴倉在即？7月剛被強平 9月又押錯方向　華爾街「AI股神」再陷倉位危機
news.Content:
曾被華爾街捧為「AI股神」的25歲避險基金經理Leopold Aschenbrenner，旗下基金Situational Awareness今年7月遭遇強平危機後，9月初重建的AI股多頭倉位近期再度承压，市場關注其看漲選擇權部位是否面臨權利金歸零風險。

Aschenbrenner曾任OpenAI「超級對齊」團隊研究員，2024年發表165頁長文《Situational Awareness》預言AI算力將吞噬晶片、記憶體與電力，隨後在舊金山成立同名基金，獲矽谷與華爾街資金追捧。其策略始終明確，重押閃迪與美光等記憶體股，押注大模型訓練帶動HBM與企業級NAND需求。

上述策略在今年上半年大賺，基金年內報酬率一度達439%，資產規模衝上450億美元，但轉折發生在今年7月下旬。美股AI硬體族群出現約兩成技術性回檔，在約4倍融資槓桿下，股價跌兩成即意味本金清零，摩根大通等重量級經紀商發出追加保證金通知並收緊信貸額度，基金被迫低價拋售持倉。

13F文件顯示，截至6月底基金美股多頭約202億美元，其中持有閃迪約57億、美光約56億，兩股合佔逾半數，強平數日內基金淨值回撤約67%，大批核心部位以約五成折讓轉讓給城堡證券(Citadel)。諷刺的是，8月相關硬體股強勁反彈，他卻已出局。

在7月致歉信中，Aschenbrenner承諾移除槓桿、改以自有資金或全額支付期權操作。上月初，Aschenbrenner轉與經紀商Clear Street合作，投入數億美元權利金買入超微、英特爾、SK海力士、SanDisk、CoreWeave等看漲選擇權，最大虧損鎖定在權利金內，券商無法盤中強平。

但選擇權引入「時間」變數。自9月建倉以來，七檔核心標的平均回跌18.3%，CoreWeave跌逾三分之一，SK海力士與閃迪跌約四分之一，現貨持有者能「躺平」等解套，選擇權卻因遠離履約價、時間價值流失而迅速萎縮；若到期前未大漲，權利金將歸零。

市場分析指出，Situational Awareness的兩次危機並非產業判斷錯誤，而是二級市場博弈邏輯不同。當基金槓桿、持倉與到期結構暴露在明處，倉位本身會成為對手盤打壓流動性的依據。數學與程式面對的是規則固定的世界，盤面價格卻是資金期限與人性博弈的結果。

隨著下月中第三季13F持倉報告即將發布，市場將確認這批選擇權真實規模。無論數字為何，Aschenbrenner三個內二度「高台跳水」已成一則樣本：數據能推演產業遠方，但價格從來只反映當下人心。

news.Title: AI燒錢過猛引爆市場疑慮　美股遇數月來最慘賣壓
news.Content:
（中央社紐約2026年10月22日綜合外電報導）受科技巨頭財報引發資本支出擔憂，加上中東局勢再度升溫，美股22日遭遇數月以來最慘烈的一波拋售潮。避險資金湧入美債，帶動美債殖利率創下逾一年來最大單日跌幅。

紐約時報指出，標普500（S&P 500）指數下跌1.2%，創7月以來最大單日跌幅；科技股比重較高的那斯達克（Nasdaq）指數則重挫2.6%，創6月以來最大單日跌幅。

投資人對科技巨頭大舉投入資金、擴張人工智慧（AI）業務的做法愈發憂慮。這些鉅額支出不僅吃掉企業現金，也迫使業者大量舉債。

科技巨擘Meta股價今天暴跌7%。Meta前一天公布財報，顯示自由現金流大幅減少，並表示將發行新類別股票，以籌措更多資金，投入資料中心及其他AI計畫。

同樣公布本季計劃再投入數百億美元擴張AI業務的SpaceX，股價也下跌逾9%。

出於對AI支出的疑慮日益升高，嚇壞的投資人轉向美國公債，尋求相對安全的資產，推動公債殖利率出現一年多來其中一個最劇烈的單日跌幅。美國10年期公債殖利率跌破5%，30年期公債殖利率則降至5.3%。

資金大舉撤出風險資產、湧向避險標的，帶動美債價格強勁反彈，殖利率創下一年多來罕見最大單日跌幅的走勢，與過去數月殖利率持續攀升的情況形成反差。

即便輝達（Nvidia）和博通（Broadcom）等原本可望受惠於科技業承諾加碼興建資料中心、採購更多晶片的晶片公司，股價也未能倖免，同樣下跌。

分析師阿邁德．汗（Malik Ahmed Khan）說：「投資人如今對整個AI生態系的健康狀況，都打上了一個大大的問號。」

英國「金融時報」指出，Meta股價重挫7%，市值蒸發約1240億美元；Meta預測未來幾年可能需要籌措「數千億美元」，以支應其押注AI的投資計畫。

巴克萊銀行（Barclays）美國通膨策略主管希爾（Jon Hill）說：「今天美國公債市場的漲勢，並非受近期任何基本面數據影響，完全是源於市場對AI行情動搖的恐慌反應。」

Meta於21日的申報文件指出，由於Alphabet等競爭對手紛紛進行大規模發債，加上Anthropic、OpenAI等新創AI巨頭在SpaceX上市後也醞釀龐大的IPO計畫，市場融資環境正面臨日趨嚴峻的挑戰。

今年以來晶片股一直是表現最突出的類股之一，投資人看好支撐AI熱潮的硬體需求將大幅成長，如今這些股票也遭到拋售。費城半導體指數重挫近7%，一名交易員指出，先前漲勢凌厲的熱門股票正面臨沉重賣壓。

美國科技股自10月初創下歷史新高以來，已歷經數波劇烈震盪。投資人擔心，AI概念股股價大幅飆升，加上企業為興建資料中心、採購晶片而大舉發債，相關投資是否已過度擴張。

投資機構Academy Securities宏觀策略主管契爾（Peter Tchir）說：「問題其實都回到AI敘事的各面向。市場究竟能否消化所有AI支出？」

news.Title: S&P 500 best performers: Zero mag 7 stocks past 13 weeks
news.Content: It's energy, not technology, that's generating the best returns this year, and that's been particularly true recently. Technology's underperformance may surprise you, given how often the media writes about artificial intelligence and how it's on track to disrupt everything from manufacturing floors to store shelves to battle fields. Yet, that's always been a Wall Street truth: Once everyone is talking about it, the easy money has already been made. Consider just how significantly the SPDR Technology ETF (XLK) has lagged other sectors since the summer. It's been essentially flat since June 30, while the SPDR Energy ETF (XLE) has gained ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Technology stocks, including the 'Magnificent Seven' (Nvidia, Microsoft, Apple, Alphabet, Tesla, Meta, Amazon), have underperformed the broader market, particularly energy stocks, over the past 13 weeks.
• Despite significant media attention on AI, the easy money in AI-related stocks may have already been made, with many Mag 7 stocks not being top S&P 500 performers recently.
• Energy stocks have seen strong returns, driven by rising crude oil prices due to geopolitical tensions, with companies like ExxonMobil and Chevron showing significant revenue and EPS growth.
• The market narrative has shifted from AI dominance in 2023 to a broader market focus, with investors now owning major AI players, reducing the upside for the largest tech companies.
news.Keywords: sector rotation, AI underperformance, energy rally, market sentiment, Magnificent Seven

news.Title: 好在有颱風？台股多休2天能躲股災？分析師：可緩衝但補跌難免
news.Content:
受到市場對 AI 資本支出疑慮與中東局勢升溫影響，美股費半暴跌逾6%，台積電 ADR 大跌 4.52%，但適逢薔琵颱風襲台，北北基桃今（23）日停班停課，台股同步休市一日，意外避開美股血洗的第一波衝擊，引發網友熱議笑稱是「護國神風」。面對今日休市加上周一光復節補假，資深分析師蔡明翰表示，颱風假與連假確實提供了「時間緩衝」，但關鍵仍需看連假期間美股能否止跌回升、開低走高，否則台股開盤後的修正與補跌依然在所難免。

颱風休市引熱議 網友幾家歡喜幾家愁

周四美股四大指數漲跌互現。道瓊工業指數微漲 11.89 點（0.02%）；那斯達克指數則重挫2.6%，創6月初以來最大單日跌幅；費城半導體指數更暴跌6.72%，其中，台積電ADR挫4.52%。

適逢薔琵颱風襲台，北北基桃宣布今日停止上班上課，台北股市、期貨及台北外匯市場同步休市一日。台股因颱風假意外避開美股暴跌的第一波衝擊，迅速在PTT等各大論壇引發熱烈討論。

不少網友慶幸直呼：「好在台股休市」、「颱風救了台股」；但也有理性與悲觀的投資人提醒，休市只是將開盤時間延後，市場累積的跌幅終究需要面對，紛紛擔心開盤會面臨補跌壓力。

休市能避開股災？ 分析師：能緩衝，但修正難免

針對美股重挫，台股今日因颱風假休市，加上周一光復節補假，等於獲得長達四天的休市緩衝，究竟能否順利避開股災？資深台股分析師蔡明翰指出，颱風假與連假確實提供了「時間緩衝」，但關鍵在於這幾天休市期間美股能否止跌回升、開低走高，否則台股開盤後的修正與補跌依然在所難免。

蔡明翰說明，當前市場格局幾乎是在複製今年7月與2024年4月的修正架構。科技股在經歷先前大漲後，正好面臨美股財報季的嚴峻考驗。目前市場氛圍偏向悲觀，焦點全放在雲端服務大廠（CSP）龐大的AI資本支出「到底能不能賺回來、未來還能不能接到訂單」，導致市場將資本支出增加解讀為利空，進而拖累整體股市修正。

翻轉訊號何時出現？ 關鍵是下周科技巨頭財報

對於大盤何時能真正扭轉頹勢，蔡明翰表示，根據歷史經驗，市場要從悲觀轉為正向，必須等待科技巨頭的財報重磅登場。在修正過程中，當企業宣布提高資本支出、市場反應卻「利空不跌、不爆反漲」時，才代表整體觀望風暴正式告一段落。

隨著Meta財報落幕，市場緊接著將焦點轉向下週公布財報的微軟（Microsoft）、Google（Alphabet）與亞馬遜（Amazon）。蔡明翰預期，在台股連假結束前，美股週五與週一有機會出現跌深反彈，這將有助於減緩台股開盤後的下殺壓力；不過在科技巨頭釋出明確利多訊號前，短線反彈後仍有賣壓，投資人宜審慎觀察後續財報表現與市場情緒轉變。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

news.Title: 薔琵成護盤關鍵？費半重挫6.7%、亞股一片綠！眾人鬆口氣：台股躲過一劫
news.Content:
中颱薔琵今（23）日襲台，全台21縣市宣布停班停課，由於昨（22）日費城半導體指數重挫逾700點，加上台股夜盤一度大跌500多點，亞股同樣也綠油油，不少投資人捏了一把冷汗，直呼「還好放颱風假」。有網友發文指出，要是今天照常開盤，恐怕又有一堆人哀嚎、嚇得臉色發青，颱風假等於替股市躲過一劫，貼文曝光後，掀起股民熱議。

費半、亞股重挫！眾人：台股放颱風假躲過一劫

一名網友在社群平台《Threads》發文表示，美股大跌六、七百點、夜盤也下挫500點，幸好颱風來襲、股市休市，否則今天又要哀鴻遍野，這場颱風假連同週末共休四天，下一場開盤要等到週二，可說是暫時逃過一劫；另一名網友則說，原本以為今天台股要血流成河，沒想到颱風一來就「暫停行刑」，昨晚費半暴跌6.7%、AI股被重擊，台股卻能直接休四天，不禁好奇週二開盤究竟是「開盤」還是「開獎」。

貼文曝光後，網友紛紛表示，「颱風假是今年最成功的護盤」，也有人認為「看今天及下週一美股、日韓股市表現，該來的躲不過」；另有網友直言「除非油價下跌，不然週二開盤還是要補跌」，還有人感嘆「連假這麼多次，每次放假前都大漲、快收假又下跌，台股只能跟著跌，來一次連假大跌、收假大漲，台股跟漲也不為過吧」，更有人喊出「躲過一劫」、「繼續殺融資」。

回頭來看國際盤勢，市場對AI相關企業資本支出的擔憂升溫，加上中東情勢緊張、油價走揚，週四美股漲跌互見：道瓊工業指數上漲11.89點、漲幅0.02%，收52867.98點；標普500指數下跌93.74點、跌幅1.21%，收7663.43點；那斯達克綜合指數下跌694點、跌幅2.6%，收26008.86點；費城半導體指數下跌773.58點、跌幅6.72%，收10731.98點。

亞股方面，截至10

news.Title: Amazon caught hackers probing a PHP flaw 4 days before the fix
news.Content: Most security breaches start with a lock nobody knew was broken. For years, that was the comfortable assumption behind the software that runs the internet. Bugs existed, but finding the dangerous ones took rare skill and a lot of time. That buffer has quietly disappeared. Artificial intelligence is now finding old flaws faster than humans can patch them, and attackers are using the same tools to turn fixes into weapons. If you have a website for your business, your side hustle or your church, this one lands on you too. The fix is free and already out. The hard part ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Amazon's security team detected attempts to exploit newly discovered PHP flaws on October 17th, four days before a fix was released.
• AI is accelerating the discovery of software vulnerabilities, making it harder to patch systems before attackers exploit them.
• The PHP flaws (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) allow unauthenticated remote code execution on vulnerable servers.
• PHP powers approximately 75% of identified websites, and the vulnerability affects versions released in the last 20 years, prompting widespread security advisories and site takedowns.
news.Keywords: cybersecurity, PHP vulnerability, AI exploitation, zero-day, patch management

news.Title: 外資千億爆砍後接「4天空窗期」...台股玩完了？野村曬數據搖頭：還有戲
news.Content:
美國CPI高於市場預期，升息疑慮再升，台股日前遭外資單日賣超高達3,025.55億元，刷新歷史紀錄。隨著光復節連假加上加上薔琵颱風，市場面臨4天空窗期。不過，外資大舉賣超是否意味台股後市轉弱？野村投信表示，回顧歷史上外資單日大幅賣超後的市場表現，短期雖受到資金撤離與市場情緒影響，但過去外資前十大賣超20個交易日後，均開始呈現正報酬，120交易日後加權指數平均總報酬更達26.7%。

野村投信統計，回顧外資單日賣超金額前十大事件，觀察後續20、60及120個交易日，台股加權指數平均總報酬分別為2.19%、19%及26.7%，呈現隨時間拉長逐步回升的趨勢。

進一步觀察大型權值股，FTSE臺灣50指數同期平均總報酬分別為2.44%、20.63%及28.98%，均優於加權指數。

若進一步聚焦創新科技，TIP臺灣創新科技50指數表現更為突出，三個期間平均總報酬分別達3.68%、32.44%及40.36%，其中120個交易日平均表現較加權指數高出13.66個百分點。顯示歷史上外資大幅調節後，具備產業競爭優勢的科技市值型企業，在市場情緒回穩後有機會展現較強的成長動能。

野村臺灣新科技50 ETF（00935）基金經理人林怡君指出，近期台股受到利率高檔、AI融資成本攀升及部分AI伺服器訂單遞延等因素影響，短線波動加劇，但AI基礎建設的長期投資趨勢仍未改變。

大型雲端服務供應商持續擴大資本支出，隨著新一代Vera Rubin平台預期於第四季末至明年第一季初逐步放量，加上客製化晶片（ASIC）出貨成長，相關供應鏈明年第一季有望呈現淡季不淡。

野村投信內部台股股票池預估2027年每股盈餘（EPS）成長約29%，顯示企業獲利仍具支撐。不過，在資金成本上升與產業競爭加劇下，供應鏈表現可能進一步分化，具備關鍵技術、穩定接單能力及良好獲利品質的一線企業，較有機會維持競爭優勢。

林怡君進一步指出，隨著AI應用由模型訓練延伸至推論，產業成長機會逐漸擴散至先進封裝、電子零組件、高速傳輸及散熱等領域，科技股布局不能只看企業規模，更應重視研發投入與技術競爭力。

許如鎧／財經特派記者，主跑經濟部、電子電信、能源等

news.Title: Google’s AI chip could become a $75 billion business
news.Content: Alphabet (GOOGL) built its artificial intelligence chips so Google would not have to depend entirely on Nvidia (NVDA) . These chips have the potential to grow into a massive enterprise. Evercore ISI predicts $75 billion in 2027 and $113 billion in 2028 sales of Google's TPUs to outside customers. As a result, technology that was initially intended to reduce Google's own computing expenses would become one of Alphabet's main new sources of income. Evercore analyst Georgia Anderson estimates TPU sales could represent roughly 35% of Google Cloud revenue in 2027 , according to Investor's Business Daily . She ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Alphabet's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) are projected to become a significant revenue stream, potentially reaching $75 billion in sales to external customers by 2027.
• TPU sales could represent approximately 35% of Google Cloud revenue in 2027, transforming an internal cost-saving measure into a major income source.
• Google is expanding TPU availability beyond its cloud, allowing customers to purchase systems for their own data centers, rent via Google Cloud, or use through infrastructure agreements.
• Google's integrated approach, controlling processors, data centers, cloud, and AI models, offers a distinct advantage over competitors like Nvidia, potentially providing 20-40% lower costs for optimized software.
news.Keywords: AI infrastructure, custom silicon, TPUs, Google Cloud, revenue diversification

news.Title: Volkswagen workers may get Microsoft AI instead of a raise
news.Content: Every company eventually has to decide what it will pay for when it can't pay for everything. For most of the last century, major industrial employers answered that question the same way. You hired people, trained them, and paid them more as they got better at the job. That bargain has been fraying for years at Volkswagen, the German group behind VW, Audi, Porsche, Skoda, and Cupra. Its chief executive has spent much of 2026 talking about job cuts, idle factory capacity, and a cost gap with rivals that he puts at roughly 20 percent. If you've ever sat through ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Volkswagen Group has equipped over 330,000 employees with Microsoft Copilot, an AI assistant integrated into Microsoft 365 applications.
• This AI rollout coincides with Volkswagen's proposal to freeze salaries at 2026 levels for the remainder of the decade, suggesting a shift in resource allocation.
• Microsoft positions this deal as a template for other industrial companies, highlighting the potential for AI to enhance productivity and drive innovation.
• The cost for Microsoft 365 Copilot for enterprise is $30 per user per month, paid yearly, with Microsoft reporting over 30 million paid seats across all customers.
news.Keywords: AI adoption, enterprise software, productivity tools, cost management, employee compensation

news.Title: 颱風假變崩盤假？夜盤狂殺近600點 專家：下周二開盤「算總帳」緊盯2件事
news.Content:
Meta財報重燃華爾街對人工智慧（AI）龐大資本支出的投資回報疑慮，引發美股周四（22日）科技股拋售潮。費城半導體指數狂瀉6.72%，台積電ADR也重挫4.52%，拖累台指期夜盤終場大跌580點，收在45654點，失守46000點大關。專家指出，這次崩跌比較像殺本益比，不像金融體系出事；由於台股連同颱風假有四天連假休市，下周二開盤前要把美股三個交易日的帳算完，投資人應緊盯周一費半收在哪，以及油價漲了多少。

美股七巨頭與晶片股全線重挫

Facebook母公司Meta第3季營收雖優於預期，但上調全年資本支出預估，且自由現金流罕見轉負，為公司IPO以來首見。此外，Meta的5年期信用違約交換（CDS）利差創歷史新高，凸顯市場對其信用風險的疑慮增加。

受此影響，美股四大指數跌多漲少，道瓊工業指數小漲0.02%，收52,867.98點；標普500指數下跌1.21%，收7,663.43點；那斯達克指數重挫2.60%，收26,008.86點；費半指數狂跌6.72%，收10,731.98點。

美股七巨頭幾乎全數失守，輝達大跌4.4%，Meta重挫6.98%，Alphabet、微軟與特斯拉均下跌2%至3%不等，僅蘋果逆勢上漲1.23%。記憶體與台股ADR同樣淪為重災區，SK海力士ADR慘跌8.07%，美光、威騰電子與希捷科技跌幅均逾6%；台積電ADR大跌4.52%，聯電ADR重挫6.51%。

台股遇四天長假 但風險不放假

台股周四早盤一度衝上47,332點高位，終場收在46,041點，單日高低點劇烈震盪1,290點並跌破季線。資深分析師周代運在臉書指出，費半指數前一天才漲1.97%，昨晚又一氣回吐三倍多，連上周五的收盤點位都踩破，市場歸咎於AI燒錢疑慮再起，加上油價往100美元靠近。

他分析，好消息是美元指數維持平盤，並非全球搶現金逃命的恐慌，熱錢還在，這點非常關鍵。由於台股連放四天假，美股周四晚、周五與周一照常交易三個交易日，下周二台股要把帳一口氣算完。

周代運認為，這次比較像殺本益比，不像金融體系出事，真卡流動性時美元通常會被搶，今天美元紋風不動。下周二開盤前，他會緊盯周一晚上費半收在哪以及油價變化，並強調「交易所可以放假，風險不放假」。

news.Title: 薔琵意外變成「護國神風」？休市一天 網喊：救了台股
news.Content:
受颱風薔琵影響，北北基桃宣布今（23）日停止上班上課。隨著台北市停班，台股、期貨及台北外匯市場也同步休市一日。此消息在PTT引發熱烈討論，有網友慶幸表示「今天的颱風假救了台股！」，甚至直呼薔琵是「護國神風」；不過也有人憂心，休市長達4天，下周二開盤時大盤漲跌幅恐將超過5%。

許多股民對於「幸運躲過一劫」大感慶幸，紛紛留言：「誰再跟我說颱風天要開市試試看」、「閃崩颱步」、「台股也懂閃身步」、「二條命躲崩 無敵了」、「多兩條命……再躲不了就是命中註定了……」、「放假躲崩！」。

同時，也有許多網友發揮幽默感，拿颱風名稱「薔琵」大玩諧音與迷因梗，笑稱「琵眼萬歲！！！！！！」、「琵眼派對」、「這次的放假可稱之為琵眼共識」、「護國神風 神山蛋雕」。

躲崩還是關廁所？ 下周開盤成焦點

不過，市場對「休市躲崩」的觀點呈現兩極化。部分網友主張休市能暫緩市場恐慌情緒，諷刺先前提議「股市應與颱風假脫鉤」的說法：「哪個說要脫鉤的？ 還好有躲崩」、「哪個捲毛說要開市的」、「是誰說股市要颱風假脫勾的？！不懂事的傢伙」。

另一方面，也有不少理性或悲觀的投資人提醒，颱風假只是延後開盤時間，累積的跌幅終究需要面對，紛紛表示：「躲崩=開盤跌停」、「上次關稅也是關廁所四天 出來直接兩根跌停」、「下星期二沒有拉起來 就是一路接鬼進大凶2027了」、「星期二要一次跌9.x%了…」、「照某人希望 颱風天照開市的玩法 今天一堆人躺平 可黏哪」、「照某人希望 颱風天照開市的玩法 今天一堆人躺平 可黏哪」、「週二百檔跌停 貪狗上山頭」。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

news.Title: 台股暴跌846點免驚？ 郭哲榮：4天後將大逆轉
news.Content:
台股22日上演劇烈震盪，加權指數開盤上漲413.05點，盤中最高來到47332.18點，隨後賣壓湧現翻黑，最低下探46041.43點，盤中高低震盪達1290.75點，終場大跌846.34點。摩爾投顧投資長郭哲榮分析，突如其來的颱風假，加上四天連假期間無法交易的不確定性，讓部分資金選擇提前賣股避險，成為短線下跌的原因之一。不過，他認為，若假期過後市場情緒逐漸穩定，台股仍有反彈機會，這波修正也可作為第四季觀察布局時機的參考，但後續走勢仍須視國際情勢與市場資金變化而定。

四天連假後必反轉

除了連假效應，郭哲榮也將目光放在國際地緣政治局勢，認為未來四天假期期間，俄烏衝突或美伊關係若出現和談進展，可能牽動國際油價及市場對通膨的預期。他分析，若衝突降溫、油價回落，全球通膨與升息疑慮有機會緩解，進而改善市場風險偏好，讓近期受到壓抑的科技股及AI相關族群迎來反彈契機。

點名國巨、華新科、環球晶

在操作策略方面，郭哲榮提醒，面對市場大幅震盪，應避免過度使用融資槓桿，以免股價回檔時承受過大壓力，甚至遭遇追繳或斷頭風險。他看好的觀察族群包括被動元件廠國巨（2327）、華新科（2492），以及矽晶圓族群環球晶（6488）、台勝科（3532），半導體供應鏈精材（3374）也在名單之中；此外，他也關注受惠半導體擴產題材的光通訊與共同封裝光學（CPO）概念股，以及股價處於相對低基期的鴻海（2317）。至於台積電（2330），他則看好其長線發展價值。

（封面圖／翻攝《郭哲榮》YT頻道）

news.Title: 台股周年慶來了！欣興、聯茂等10檔優先鎖定 2類不要碰
news.Content:
台股昨（22日）跌破季線，回測46K大關，且周四美股重挫，台積電ADR暴跌4.52%，台股今（23日）因為颱風假暫時躲過一劫，但在盤勢疲弱之際，後市並不是非常樂觀。由於台股大盤疲弱，此時如何選股相當重要，分析師陳威良坦言，這時是優質股的「周年慶機會」。

超額報酬機會來了！低檔布局好機會？

以權值股台積電與大立光為例，台積電基本面持續成長，但股價卻出現拉回，每當這兩種狀況出現，其實往往是賺取超額報酬的機會，目前沒有任何一家法人的目標價在3000元以下，拉回反而是好機會。

陳威良於直播中提到，大立光雖在季線附近，但投信一直在買，並沒有因為股價從7460元拉回而撤退，反而持續加碼；外資也在近期回頭買超大立光，展現低檔布局的企圖心，因此就算大立光在往下修正一些，依然是替明年布局的好機會。

看好載板、CCL及設備！兩大族群先不要碰

另外，陳威良提到載板、CCL及設備族群，欣興、南電、景碩及臻鼎-KY存在低檔布局機會；銅箔基板CCL聯茂、台光電及台燿等強勢股拉回並不需要太擔心，基本面仍是最大靠山，股價都會反映。

設備股中，陳威良點名大量，強勢股拉回維持上升趨勢，法人已給予2000元目標價，且毛利率從第二季的44.2%跳升超過10%，受惠於PCB擴產、CPO及半導體，且高階設備比重會增加至70%。

至於此時不該碰的族群，陳威良提到，炒作過頭的光學股，或者新材料族群PTFE等跌幅很重，「這些股票本來就是極為短線，真要碰要拿得起放得下，設好停利停損，畢竟基本面是不到位的。」

news.Title: 費半崩跌逾6%！ 台指期夜盤失守46K 日韓股也遭殃
news.Content:
金融市場對AI資本支出上升的不安情緒加深、國際油價飆升影響，美股費半指數崩跌6.72%，連帶日韓股同步下殺，韓股KOSPI指數早盤一度下跌逾4%，來到5300點，日經225指數也下跌逾2%，台指期夜盤同步跳水，最低來到45648點失守46K，最終收在45654，下跌580點，跌幅1.25%

Meta財報雖然優於預期，但由於AI資本支出持續攀升，近十年來首次出現自由現金流由正轉負，而Meta宣布，將通過2比1拆股方式發行無投票權股票以籌措資金，Meta五年期信用違約交換(CDS)報價，也創下這類合約約一年前開始活躍交易以來最高；消息曝光後，公司股價應聲下跌近7%，進而影響AMD、輝達、美光、CoreWeave等科技巨頭股價同步下挫。

除了科技股資本支出帶來的疑慮，根據《紐約時報》引述消息人士指出，美國與以色列計劃在美國期中選舉後對伊朗發動新一輪攻擊，美國總統川普更直言「很快就會發生某些事情」，讓原油價格再度攀升，影響資金出逃。

亞股也受美股下挫影響，韓股KOSPI指數早盤一度下跌逾4%，來到5300點，日經225指數也下跌逾2%，台股今（23）日雖受颱風假影響未開盤，不過前一交易日終場收跌846點、失守季線，台指期夜盤同步跳水，最低來到45648點失守46K，最終收在45654，下跌580點，跌幅1.25%，下週開盤恐面臨龐大的修正壓力。

news.Title: AI交易風向球跌！南韓KOSPI率亞洲股市下挫 日元和美債成避風港
news.Content:
科技股賣壓加劇， 被視為人工智慧(AI)交易風向球的南韓KOSPI指數周五(23日)早盤下挫，權值晶片股隨美股前日賣壓走弱，MSCI亞太股市連續第二天下跌，回落至7月以來的水準附近。美股期貨乏力，那斯達克100指數期貨下跌0.1%。

KOSPI截稿前跌幅為1.8%，盤中一度下跌3.1%，正邁向連續第四周周線收黑。三星電子下跌逾2%，SK海力士(SK Hynix)早盤跌3%，該公司正式中止Solidigm在美國的首次公開發行(IPO)計畫，另尋美國建廠資金來源。

日本日經225指數盤中跌1.3.%或854點。台灣股市受颱風影響，周五休市。

AI交易重挫之際，投資人尋求避險，公債和日元受益。美國公債周四創下逾兩年來最大漲市之後，周五續揚，殖利率反向走低，10年期美債殖利率周五報4.96%，日本和澳洲公債同步上漲。日元在亞洲早盤升值0.4%，報156.20。

韓股10月跌20% 全球最差

隨著市場擔憂大規模AI投資能否持續、借貸成本恐不斷攀升，韓股正飽受賣壓，KOSPI 10月至今已下跌約20%，成為全球主要股市中10月表現最差的市場。

由於韓股的AI概念股占比高，走勢經常隨著投資人對情緒波動而起伏。Fibonacci Asset Management Global執行長Jung In Yun說：「投資人愈來愈質疑，大規模AI支出究竟需要多久才能轉化為可持續的現金流，而油價上漲又增添了一層不確定性。市場情緒看來相當脆弱，投資人優先考慮保本，而不是逢低買進。」

根據韓國金融投資協會(Korea Financial Investment Association)，南韓券商的投資人存款餘額已降至90兆韓元(679億美元)以下，為1月以來首見。交易員指出，存款餘額下降意味著散戶對股市的支撐力道可能有限。

news.Title: 從「晶片荒」到「紅海」？ 輝達黃仁勳：2029年記憶體市場過剩可能性不大
news.Content:
過去一週，全球記憶體晶片股遭遇劇烈拋售，市場瀰漫著對供應過剩與需求疲軟的擔憂，但輝達執行長黃仁勳週四(22日)在德國GTC大會期間公開反駁這一悲觀論調，為市場注入一劑強心針。

引發本輪拋售潮的導火線，是韓媒上周援引專家觀點報導警告，隨著大量新增產能開出，預計到2029年半導體市場將變成「紅海」，超級週期可能結束，行業恐將進入低迷期。受此影響，美股記憶體族群週四集體重挫，其中閃迪大跌8.51%，SK海力士跌8.07%，美光科技跌6.23%，Roundhill記憶體ETF(DRAM)亦重挫7.08%。

面對市場恐慌，黃仁勳在柏林受訪時展現極度樂觀的態度。他明確表示：「到2029年出現記憶體供應過剩的可能性不大。」他指出，記憶體技術的獨特之處在於「你永遠可以用得更多」。

黃仁勳強調，HBM在未來數年仍將是核心零組件，並提到輝達是首家將手機用的LPDDR記憶體引入資料中心的公司，這種創新使其能效達到業界標準的兩倍，未來將繼續大量採用此類記憶體。

儘管黃仁勳試圖安撫市場，但週四美股科技板塊依然大跌，那斯達克收跌2.6%。分析人士指出，除地緣政治緊張局勢外，黃仁勳關於「資本短缺制約AI擴張」的言論，以及Meta披露的天價支出計畫，反而加劇市場對科技巨頭舉債建設AI基礎設施的擔憂。

不過，從基本面來看，需求依然強勁。美國Western Digital週四公佈的財報顯示，第一財季淨營收達43.8億美元，大幅年增55%，調整後EPS達4.64美元，均大幅優於市場預期，顯示在AI浪潮推動下，記憶體市場的「多空交戰」仍將持續。

news.Title: Meta自由現金流轉負！ 費半慘崩逾6% 台積電ADR也跌4.5%
news.Content:
在市場對AI成本支出上升的不安情緒加深，以及中東局勢緊張、油價走揚的背景下，美股週四表現分歧，道瓊指數小漲0.02%；那斯達克指數則大跌2.6%，創下自6月初以來最大單日跌幅；標普500指數下滑1.21%，為7月來最糟單日表現；費城半導體指數重挫6.72%，台積電ADR也下跌4.52%。

Meta財報表現優於分析師預期，但由於AI支出持續攀升，近十年來首次出現自由現金流由正轉負，Meta宣布，將通過2比1拆股方式發行無投票權股票以籌措資金；消息曝光，公司股價應聲下跌近7%；AI雲端基礎設施主要供應商的CoreWeave，也因債券殖利率及信用違約交換利率仍在高檔，股價重挫逾10%。

其餘半導體類股也同步走弱，AMD重挫8.1%，輝達下跌4.4%，美光跌幅達6.26%，特斯拉的季度獲利雖然優於市場預期，但因下修全年資本支出至200億美元，股價也下跌3.1%。

此外，《紐約時報》引述消息人士指出，美國與以色列計畫於美國期中選舉後再次對伊朗發動攻擊，讓國際油價再度攀升。美國總統川普21日則表態，華盛頓不會與德黑蘭展開談判，並表示「很快」將有結果，市場持續緊張的中東局勢可能讓通膨居高不下，使聯準會繼續維持升息壓力。

news.Title: 台股靠颱風假躲過一劫…下周補跌？散戶操盤有2種解法
news.Content:
台股今（23日）颱風假休市，要等到光復節連假過後，下周二才會恢復交易，因此台股算是躲過周四美股暴跌，台積電ADR慘摔4.52%的衝擊。資深外匯專家李其展建議投資人，操作上盡量靈活一點，如果沒有信心能低買到好企業，應考慮市值型ETF或者乾脆先觀望，等這一波利空過去，也是不錯的選擇。

美股慘崩怎辦？專家解答

科技股又成為殺盤重心，Meta暴跌6.98%，亞馬遜重挫4.57%，Google母公司Alphabet也摔3.08%，半導體與人工智慧族群慘烈，輝達下跌4.40%，超微AMD重挫8.10%，美光也下殺6.26%，資金流入傳產、金融、能源及醫藥族群。

李其展於臉書自曝操作，「這一波還是走買Alpha賣Beta路線。」李其展指出，那斯達克與費半是主要受創區，但道瓊一度翻紅，顯示防禦性類股有買盤支撐的分歧，而不是全面拋售。

言下之意代表，專注在個股操作，先剔除大盤整體的漲跌風險，通常用在看不清整體市場大盤會往哪裡走，但很確定某些標的特別強、某些特別弱的時候。李其展也建議投資人若沒有把握挑到好公司，觀望或市值型ETF也是好方法。

搶進債市？千萬不要有這個心態

資金離開高估值族群後，除了值轉進其他類股避險，債市也分一杯羹，10年期美債殖利率跌破5%。李其展直言「美債投資人等來春天」投資級與非投資級債都跟著反彈，看起來是固定收益相關的有資金流入，不是單純避險買盤支撐。

另外，李其展觀察，有一點值得注意，股市有壓力資金進公債合理，尤其歐洲債務也有風險的環境下，但通常非投資級債不受惠，這次目前卻還不錯。李其展建議投資人，以資產配置或現金流的角度投資債券，而不是賺取利差為目標。

news.Title: 費半崩近7％台股剉咧等！黃仁勳戳中AI痛點 說出市場最怕的事
news.Content:
美股科技股再掀拋售潮，輝達執行長黃仁勳一席話，戳中AI熱潮痛點，費城半導體指數重挫近7％，台積電ADR及輝達下跌逾4%，拖累台指期夜盤昨（22）日下殺580點收4萬5654點，失守46K大關。受颱風影響，台股暫時避開美股重挫的直接衝擊，但下周二恢復交易後，仍將面臨國際科技股下跌的壓力。

市場賣壓主要來自兩大因素。首先，中東地緣政治風險升溫，沙烏地阿拉伯遭遇致命攻擊，加深市場對原油供應中斷的憂慮。《紐約時報》引述知情人士指出，美國與以色列正計畫於美國期中選舉結束後，再度對伊朗發動軍事打擊，推升布倫特原油價格突破每桶113美元，通膨疑慮再度升高。

其次，AI投資所需的龐大資金引發市場不安。Meta預估，未來幾年為支應AI布局，將需要籌措數千億美元，最快今年秋季啟動融資。消息公布後，Meta股價重挫近7%，市值蒸發約1240億美元。隨著Alphabet等科技巨頭大舉發債，加上Anthropic、OpenAI等企業籌備上市，市場資金競爭日益激烈，科技業的融資壓力逐漸浮現。

輝達執行長黃仁勳受訪時更指出，新興雲端服務需求強勁，但資金供給不足，已成為產業發展的瓶頸。市場擔憂，當AI投資規模持續擴大，企業能否順利取得資金，以及投資報酬能否支撐龐大支出，都將成為影響科技股估值的關鍵。

黃仁勳點出新雲端的發展瓶頸，目前缺乏推動成長的營運資金，因為AI各領域的需求龐大，導致資金短缺。

黃仁勳這番說法，也呼應了近期博通執行長陳福陽的疑慮。陳福陽表示，資金短缺是限制AI發展的最大阻礙，並非晶片供應。

因回收投資所需的時間超出預期，市場對企業AI基礎建設支出規模抱持的疑慮加深，正讓市場感到不安。

news.Title: 看好2027年美股！避險基金大亨艾克曼：若戰爭與通膨降溫 市場將迎來強勁一年
news.Content:
潘興廣場資本(Pershing Square)執行長艾克曼(Bill Ackman)周四(22日)說，俄烏衝突、美伊戰爭、高通膨與高利率正壓抑本應更強勁的市場環境，但隨著地緣政治風險緩解、能源價格回落，「2027年將是令人驚艷的一年」。

他在接受《CNBC》訪問時表示，美伊戰爭「執行得極為出色」，認為中東若走向和平，不僅有利該區，也將惠及美國。他的樂觀判斷核心在於：戰事不確定性消退→油價大跌→通膨壓力減輕→Fed貨幣緊縮壓力下降。

今年以來，美國原油價格累計上漲72%、布蘭特期油漲78％，能源成本已明顯傳導至消費端；美國9月CPI年增3.7％，汽油貢獻當月漲幅一半以上。

目前利率維持高位，一方面壓抑本益比與經濟活動，另一方面若過早放鬆又恐讓通膨黏著，Fed陷入兩難。艾克曼坦言，上述好轉前提仍取決於地緣局勢與通膨走勢能否如預期改善。

個股布局上，他持續看好Netflix稱市場對內容儲備的擔憂被誇大，目前本益比約18倍處歷史低位，獲利可維持中高個位數至雙位數增長，「Netflix像一種高成長公用事業公司」。

Meta則是艾克曼的核心持股，他看好個人AI智能體Muse與廣告業務受惠AI，認為市場不應只看財報隔日股價反應，當前估值仍低估。

艾克曼還重申對房利美、房地美的看多立場，稱兩家機構資本基礎已重建至歷史水準五倍，「這些股票將漲十倍」，是風險報酬最不對稱的標的。

整體而言，即便短期受戰爭與高利率壓制，艾克曼仍押注優質企業長期盈利與估值修復空間。

news.Title: 1分鐘讀財經》台積電ADR狂殺 夜盤又遭血洗！主動式ETF押「這3檔」保命？
news.Content:
小編今天（23）日精選5件國內外重要財經大事。由於市場對科技巨頭砸巨資投入AI的投資報酬率疑慮再起，美股週四（22日）科技與晶片股淪為重災區，費城半導體指數大幅重挫6.72%。其中台積電ADR暴跌4.52%，導致台指期夜盤終場狂跌580點，收在45,654點，失守46,000點大關。不過，台股今（23日）正好碰上颱風假休市，暫時躲過了這波崩盤賣壓。

台股近日跌破重要均線，多空交鋒持續升溫，伴隨盤勢劇烈震盪，各家主動式ETF經理人選股策略原先高度集中在科技股持股的版圖開始洗牌，目前僅剩台積電、台光電、聯發科三檔穩居ETF標配陣容，22日跌破季線，更見經理人狂加金融與傳產股。

【1】台股破季線 主動式ETF趁低掃貨

盤點22日主動式ETF經理人逢低進場掃貨標的，涵蓋台積電、鴻海、日月光投控、聯電等科技權值龍頭，還有台泥、南亞、台化、大成鋼、華航、中華電等低基期傳產股，另有欣銓、聯茂、台燿與力積電等電子零組件個股入列。值得注意的是，欣興、奇鋐、南亞、聯茂、日月光投控及中信金等6檔，更獲得至少2檔主動式台股ETF逢低同步加碼，成為經理人共識的低檔加碼首選。

【2】聯發科法說倒數 雙外資送暖

繼台積電與大立光之後，市場最關注的科技法說會聯發科，將在30日舉行。花旗環球證券指出，市場一直對聯發科TPU開發進度，以及新專案拓展抱持懷疑態度，但聯發科TPU v8專案進展符合預期，今年相關營收可望達到20億美元以上，將成為推動第四季營收強勁成長的重要催化劑（catalyst）；野村證券則提出，市場對聯發科部分擔憂過度，重申「買進」投資評等。

【3】勞保費率明年調升為13％ 雇主年成本增逾百億元

勞動部勞保局22日指出，依《勞工保險條例》規定，勞工保險保險費率自明年1月1日起，由現行12.5％調整為13％，經扣除內含的就業保險費率1％，2027年起，將以12％計收勞工保險保險費。據估算，雇主明年全年可能因此增加逾133.3億元的法定成本。

【4】AI基建燒錢 Meta自由現金流轉負 降至負21.2億美元

Meta公布第三季財報，營收創歷史新高，第四季財測也優於市場預期，但AI軍備競賽的代價浮現。公司調高2026年資本支出預估下限，自由現金流更創上市以來首度轉負，22日早盤股價重挫逾6％。

【5】特斯拉Q3業績報喜 下修全年資本支出

特斯拉第三季業績報喜，營收和獲利雙雙優於市場預期，且資本支出低於華爾街預測，讓上季現金流意外轉正，該公司同時下修全年資本支出。

news.Title: Meta財報引爆「AI恐慌」！台指期夜盤一度崩500點
news.Content:
財經中心／李明融報導

美國科技巨頭Meta最新財報掀起全球資本市場的「AI支出恐慌」，美股晶片與科技族群周四（22日）慘遭血洗！儘管Meta第三季營收締造新猷，但龐大的AI資本支出承諾與十多年來首見的現金淨流出，引發市場對高額融資與投資報酬率的嚴重焦慮，拖累那斯達克指數重挫2.6%、費城半導體指數狂瀉6.7%。指標晶片股全面遭到無情拋售，超微（AMD）崩跌逾7%、台積電ADR大跌超過4.5%，連帶引爆台股夜盤劇烈動盪，台指期夜盤盤中不敵龐大賣壓一度狂殺500點、摜破46,000點大關，觸及45,733點低檔，市場避險情緒急速升溫。

Meta加碼AI爆現金淨流出！費半狂瀉6.7%創波段最慘　台積電ADR跌逾4.5%

news.Title: 〈美股盤後〉Meta重燃AI交易恐慌 費半狂瀉近7% 台積電ADR跌超4.5%
news.Content:
Meta 財報重燃華爾街人工智慧 (AI) 交易恐慌後，科技股暴跌。投資人紛紛拋售晶片股，轉而投資更具防禦性的板塊。費半指數週四 (22日) 狂瀉近7%，那斯達克指數下跌2.6%，創下四個多月以來的最大單日跌幅，債市出現逾 1 年來最大單日漲勢。

中東局勢升溫，推升油價觸及 5 個月高點，也加深市場不安，資金轉向美債避險，10年期公債殖利率跌破5%。

市場傳出，美國與以色列正研擬在美國期中選舉後，再度對伊朗發動攻擊的計畫，加上沙烏地阿拉伯機場及油田遇襲並傳出死傷，進一步升高能源供應疑慮。

《華爾街日報》週四引述美國官員報導，美國總統川普週三致電 SpaceX 執行長馬斯克，要求解除對烏克蘭軍用版星鏈 (Starlink) 的限速措施。美烏官員表示，通話後，系統運作已於週四改善，但尚未完全恢復正常。

經濟數據方面，美國上週初領失業金降至19.4萬人，創三個月新低，低於預期，顯示裁員活動仍維持低檔。

隨著科技股下挫、市場金融條件收緊，投資人下修聯準會 (Fed) 年內再度升息的預期，貨幣市場已不再完全反映年底前升息 1 碼的可能性。

美股週四 (22 日) 主要指數表現：

道瓊工業指數上漲 11.89 點，或 0.02%，報 52,867.98 點。

那斯達克指數下跌 694.00 點，或 2.60%，報 26,008.86 點。

S&P 500 指數下跌 93.74 點，或 1.21%，報 7,663.43 點。

費城半導體指數下跌 773.58 點，或 6.72%，報 10,731.98 點。

NYSE FANG+ 指數下跌 587.66 點，或 3.12%，報 18,260.12 點。

焦點個股

NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭僅蘋果收紅。Meta (META-US) 重挫 6.98%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 上漲 1.23%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 下跌 3.15%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 下跌 2.23%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 下跌 4.57%。

半導體主要個股全面下挫。AMD (AMD-US) 重挫 8.10%；博通 (AVGO-US) 下跌 4.31%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 下跌 4.40%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 重挫 8.16%；高通 (QCOM-US) 下跌 2.88%。

記憶體與儲存族群全面重挫。美光 (MU-US) 下跌 6.26%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 下跌 6.43%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 下跌 8.51%；希捷 (STX-US) 下跌 7.86%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 下跌 8.07%。

台股 ADR 跌多漲少。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 下跌 4.52%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 重挫 11.01%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 下跌 6.51%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 上漲 2.57%。

企業新聞

威騰電子 (WDC-US) 週四收低超 6%，盤後續跌超 4%，儘管威騰電子盤後公布最新財報與財測均優於預期，仍難抵 AI 概念股整體走弱的壓力。分析指出，投資人持續擔憂硬碟產業榮景能否延續，加上東芝計劃於 2027 會計年度將 AI 資料中心用硬碟產能提高至原來的 2 倍，引發市場對供給增加、威騰電子議價能力及毛利率成長空間受壓的疑慮。

Facebook 母公司 Meta (META-US) 下跌 7%。Meta 第 3 季財報表現穩健，營收優於華爾街預期。儘管當季資本支出低於預期，公司仍上調全年資本支出預估中間值，且第 3 季自由現金流轉為負值，這是自公司 IPO 以來首次出現負自由現金流。

同時，Meta 的 5 年期信用違約交換 (CDS) 利差週四升至歷史新高，顯示隨著公司持續擴大 AI 支出，投資人對其信用風險的疑慮升溫。

特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 收黑 3.1% 至每股 374.58 美元。馬斯克旗下這家電動車製造商第 3 季獲利略優於預期，營收則與去年同期大致持平。不過，隨著新技術投入增加，營業利益不如預期。

SpaceX (SPCX-US) 下殺 9.1% 至每股 144.75 美元，主要隨半導體大盤下滑，加上特斯拉財報電話會議也未提供SpaceX 與特斯拉潛在合併案的進一步消息。此外，《路透》報導，部分參與協商人士擔心，馬斯克公開支持合併，可能引發股東對交易公平性的質疑，並拖慢協商進度，為交易前景增添變數。

科林研發 (LRCX-US) 慘崩約 12% 至每股 230.15 美元，是標普最差的成分股之一。這家半導體設備製造商第 1 季度獲利雖略優於華爾街預期，仍難以滿足投資人對 AI 相關企業的高度期待。

華爾街分析

BMO Capital Markets 策略師 Ian Lyngen 表示，科技股估值修正，促使投資人重新思考聯準會 (Fed) 政策方向。若股市下跌已使金融條件收緊，Fed 進一步緊縮的必要性可能降低，這也帶動市場下修年底前再度升息的押注。

Edward Jones 經濟學家 James McCann 指出，科技股經歷大幅上漲後，市場越加要求企業拿出 AI 投資回報的具體證據，高利率也讓投資人更加質疑龐大支出能否持續。他仍看好大型股，但提醒投資人維持投資組合的分散配置。

黑石總裁 Jon Gray 則淡化 AI 泡沫疑慮，表示 AI 需求正急速成長。他認為，典型泡沫往往是先擴建產能，再期待需求出現，但目前 AI 產業的情況是需求強勁，供給仍努力追趕。

不過，Citadel 創辦人 Ken Griffin 日前警告，目前 AI 熱潮中「幾乎肯定存在泡沫」。他也指出，重大經濟轉型往往伴隨泡沫，但仍可能孕育出長期勝出的企業。

news.Title: 友達ADR22日下跌0.81美元跌幅7.06%折台股34.69元
中華電信ADR22日上漲1.22美元漲幅2.57%折台股158.38元
聯電ADR22日下跌1.29美元跌幅6.51%折台股120.47元
名師操盤》台股崩盤怎麼辦？蔡正華：鎖定3大多頭火種
news.Content:
儘管美股出現反彈，但在市場提前反應盤後所公布的企業財報，市場對於AI基建的回報時間以及融資成本擔憂持續下，亞洲科技股普遍走弱。周四的台股，反映投資人對於AI產業的疑慮，加上颱風恐停班，以及後續光復節連假在即，指數呈現開高走低，早盤最高來到47332點後，隨即不願抱股過節的賣壓出籠。

行情一路走低，終場下跌846點，以46041點作收，收在全日最低，K線收黑K，成交量為8792億元，較前一日的8331億元，呈現價跌量增，顯示隨著連假在即，加上多方未能續攻，市場心態轉趨保守，不少籌碼轉為隔日沖，寧願先離場，等待美股財報及連假變數釐清再說。

以日K線來看，週三多方一度嘗試抵抗，但是週四行情隨即再創新低，顯示多方抵抗失敗，同時週四收盤也跌破了季線支撐，目前季線位置約在46207點，短線持續由空方主導。在日級別日出訊號出現前，行情仍有探底風險。

若以週K線來看，由於上週剛出現週級別日落訊號，等於中線由多翻空，本來就需要時間整理，先前預估至少2~3週。本週的週K線由於至今未能拉出下影線，行情暫無轉折訊號(如十字或小紅)，故整理期拉長難免，先觀察日K線何時不再破底，週K線何時能否轉折，而由於週K線仍由空方佔上風，權值電子易被壓抑，操作仍以中小型股為先，多方火種也在其中。

至於OTC指數，本波由於率先跌破季線，季線成為上檔反壓，目前的架構比加權指數還要弱勢。先前提過OTC指數有下探年線的風險，目前看來測試年線的機率持續增加。以台股的日KD指標來看，目前日KD值一度收斂未果，反而向下擴大，現已雙雙跌落到20以下，進入弱勢格局。一旦KD值進入弱勢格局，行情將持續被壓抑，多方若要維繫人氣，至少要適時表態，否則人氣會退潮。

盤面上，個股跌多漲少，顯示資金普遍站在賣方，追價力道偏於保守。週三嘗試反彈的低軌衛星、CPO、液冷散熱、被動元件等，週四隨即遭遇強烈空抵，顯示籌碼仍不穩。反而先前提過的轉型CPO族群、PCB供應鏈(含銅箔基板、玻纖布)，還有AI資訊安全股、中線多頭結構並未被破壞，初步可視為多頭火種，值得持續追蹤。

news.Title: 外資倒貨 台股上沖下洗1290點
news.Content:
台股22日開高走低，開盤先受美股激勵，早盤上漲逾400點，最高來到4萬7332.18點，沒想到薔琵颱風來攪局，加上中東戰火升溫、油價上漲，多空激戰下，走勢宛如雲霄飛車，避險、賣壓多重壓力，權值股由台積電、台達電領跌，指數急轉直下，終場大跌846.34點，收在最低點的4萬6041.43點，上下震盪1290點，4萬6千點險些失守，成交量9334億元。不過，分析師認為，等底部訊號浮現後，投資人宜偏多操作。

摩爾證券投顧分析師郭哲榮分析，台股早盤跟著美股開高，但投資人聽聞薔琵颱風要放假就先落跑，加上光復節等於連放4天假，根本不知道長假期間會發生什麼事，乾脆「先賣再說」，對台股形成龐大賣壓。

大型權值股台達電跌4％最顯著、收在1560元，聯發科也重挫3.14％、跌了130元來到4010元，台積電下跌1.45％、35元，收盤價為2385元。至於台指期夜盤昨晚間9點處於平盤上下震盪。

台股狂瀉846點摜破季線，統一投顧董事長黎方國分析，美國期中選舉，總統川普恐失國會優勢，加上美國通膨難降，聯準會10月升息仍有3成的可能性，外資昨大動作提款816億元，3大法人共賣超1001億元，種種負面雜訊對台股短線形成壓力。

郭哲榮認為，光復節連假後，台股有機會反彈向上，因為隨美國期中選舉結果揭曉逼近，台灣4天連假期間，川普很可能對美伊戰爭談判、俄烏戰爭結束宣示新進展，屆時油價就有機會下跌，股市會因此而噴出。

台股指數進入4萬6千點保衛戰，黎方國認為，台股最壞狀況已經過去，底部訊號浮現後，宜偏多操作，尤其台股第4季多呈現易漲難跌的趨勢；他指出，過去10年美股在11月有9次（年）呈現上漲，緊接的12月是台股最容易上漲月份，過去10年有8次（年）上漲，勝率相對較高。黎方國指出，我國第4季外銷訂單、出口數據仍可望維持亮眼表現，企業財報持續轉佳等基本面支撐，台股年底前上看5萬點，明年有機會朝5萬5千點前進，指數距離現在還有近8、9000點的操作空間。

美國期中選舉後國會控制權也可能重新洗牌，市場擔憂民主黨若拿下國會多數席次，恐牽制川普施政，甚至衝擊AI資料中心建設，讓高度仰賴美國科技巨頭資本支出的台股面臨考驗。

根據「鉅亨買基金」分析，選舉結果確實可能加劇短線震盪，但國會變天，不等於終結AI投資熱潮，更不代表台股多頭行情就此反轉；相較政治版圖變化，企業獲利、AI需求及資本支出能否延續，才是決定台股中長期走勢的關鍵。

news.Title: 台股推動銀行業高歌猛進　存股最推5檔
news.Content:
國內研究機構發布最新金融族群專題研究報告指出，受惠於資本市場持續熱絡、出口貿易暢旺及制度接軌革新，台灣金融控股公司整體營運展現強勁成長動能。在壽險獲利跳升、銀行放款與手續費雙增，以及證券自營與經紀業務大幅成長下，預期2026年金融族群整體營運將持續向好。銀行業務方面，受惠於出口持續暢旺，截至8月底國銀放款餘額較去年同期年增12%，帶動淨利息收益成長17.9%。此外，資本市場熱絡亦激勵手續費收入年增24.2%。觀察國銀逾期放款比率及備抵呆帳覆蓋率均維持正常水準，未見異常，顯示銀行業在獲利高歌猛進的同時，風險控制與資產品質依然良好。

新制驅動大跳升 六大壽險創佳績

壽險業在2026年接軌IFRS17新制後，負債成本大幅下降推升經常性收益增長，加上契約服務邊際（CSM）挹注與資本市場上行之金融資產評價利益，帶動獲利顯著跳升。2026上半年全體壽險業保費收入達13181億元，年增16.2%，其中首年保費收入（FYP）達5062億元，年增35.1%。截至8月底，國泰金（2882）、富邦金（2881）、新光金（2888）、南山、凱基金（2883）、旗下擁台壽的中信金（2891）等六大壽險與母金控合計稅後淨利達2207億元，年增高達2.2倍。儘管美債殖利率創高致7月產生金融資產評價損失，六大壽險7月稅後淨利僅61.2億元，但8月隨台股走揚獲利已快速回升。截至8月底全體壽險業外價金約11015億元，能有效抵禦匯率波動並降低避險成本，本土投顧法人推估全年獲利將顯著年增49.3%。

台股爆量飆兆元 自營經紀雙發動

證券業方面，受惠於股市多頭行情，台股日均成交量衝上10024億元，相較2025年日均5325億元大幅成長88.2%。資本市場波動同步挹注自營收入相較去年同期大幅跳升333.5%，帶動整體證券業前8月稅後淨利達1824.7億元，年增195%。雖然7月受美伊衝突惡化影響致自營收益稍有縮減，但9月台股日均成交量仍高居1兆1051億元。在資本利得持續挹注下，國內研究機構預計2026年證券業全年獲利將較2025年再創新高。台灣金融業在壽險、銀行與證券三大核心業務引擎同步發動下，展現出強大的抵禦波動能力與營運韌性，未來隨著各項制度接軌與資本市場熱度延續，金融族群可望持續扮演台股中堅力量。

news.Title: 資金為AI泡沫買保險 美股「最不希望漲的類股」漲起來了
news.Content:
美股「最不希望漲的板塊」漲起來了。隨著人工智慧（AI）泡沫疑慮升溫，醫療保健股躍居標普500指數近期表現最佳類股之一，估值也從一年前較大盤折價25%，轉為略享溢價。這波漲勢背後，反映投資人正轉向防禦，為AI行情可能逆轉預作準備。

《華爾街日報》報導稱，投資人擔心利率上升可能壓抑AI資本支出，正將資金從波動較大的科技股，轉向獲利較穩定、受景氣循環影響較小的醫療保健類股。

SPDR 健康護理指數 ETF( XLV-US ) 周一上漲逾2%，莫德納( MRNA-US ) 大漲6.7%，必治妥施貴寶( BMY-US ) 上漲4.9%。根據FactSet數據，XLV預估本益比已升至19.3倍，略高於標普500整體水準。

醫療股過去在信用緊縮、科技泡沫破裂期間，往往能跑贏大盤。如今這項防禦特性再度受到重視，但也讓漲勢帶有警訊意味：愈來愈多投資人開始為市場下跌買進「保險」。

從折價25%到溢價 市場風向逆轉

過去幾年，醫療股受到藥品定價壓力、保險公司醫療成本攀升，以及AI投資熱潮排擠，長期遭市場冷落。一年前相較大盤仍有25%的估值折價，如今已全數消失。

高盛美國醫療保健研究主管Asad Haider指出，醫療股要維持估值溢價，通常需要三項條件：投資人對醫療創新有信心、擔憂其他產業獲利能否延續，以及政策不確定性相對可控。他認為，目前這些條件已大致到位。

歷史上，醫療股享有估值溢價的時期，主要集中在2003至2007年、2013至2015年。2022年底通膨高漲、聯準會積極升息期間，也曾短暫出現。

其中，2000年代中期與當前環境具有相似之處。當時中東衝突推升能源價格，聯準會持續升息，房市繁榮支撐經濟獲利；如今則由AI扮演成長引擎。兩個時期共同的疑問都是，借貸成本持續攀升，繁榮還能維持多久？

2004至2007年，標普500預估本益比從約18倍降至約15倍，醫療股則憑藉較穩定的獲利，持續享有溢價。

明日預定進行除權息與現金增資相關作業之公司，日程順延一天辦理，包括威致(2028-TW)原定 10/23 發放現金股利 0.2 元；青松健康(6931-TW)原定 10/23 發放現金股利 0.12 元；鼎晉生技(7876-TW)原定 10/23 辦理現金增資 1.5 億元(認購率 11.8057%，認購價 40 元)。

部分預定於明日發放現金股利的上市櫃公司，若投資人選擇以「匯款轉帳」方式領取，因停班地區金融機構的匯款轉帳作業日程需順延至下一營業日，因此受停班影響縣市的投資人，現金股利入帳日將順延 1 天；至於未受颱風停班影響縣市之投資人，則仍會依原訂日期收到現金股利。

news.Title: Meta Stock Slips Despite 10 Million Muse Sign-Ups
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Meta Platforms ( NASDAQ:META ) reported third-quarter diluted EPS of $3.83, including a $9.89 billion charge tied to its settlement with 52 state attorneys general over teen mental health litigation. Excluding the charge, EPS would have been $7.40, above the analysts' consensus of $6.54. Revenue rose 26% to $64.60 billion, ahead of the $63.34 billion estimate. Meta shares fell 1.35% in premarket.

Is META fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator.

Average price per ad rose 14% and ad impressions 10%. Capital expenditures reached $34.91 billion, leaving free cash flow at negative $2.12 billion. Free cash flow turned negative for the first time since 2012. Meta guided fourth-quarter revenue to $73 billion to $76 billion and narrowed its 2026 capex outlook to $135 billion to $145 billion, from $130 billion to $145 billion. Our investments are paying off, the core business is strong, CEO Mark Zuckerberg said.

On the earnings call , Zuckerberg said more than 10 million people in the U.S. and Canada had set up Muse personal agents in about a month and a half, with about 25% using it on any given day. He said existing Muse users in the U.S. generate several hundred dollars a year each in Family of Apps revenue, and that Meta expects Muse to reach an even higher level over time because of the commerce it already sees. Muse is compute-intensive, but Meta expects to improve its cost efficiency more than tenfold in the next year.

news.Title: Meta's new nonvoting shares create an overhang — and Wall Street wants it gone
news.Content:
Meta ( META ) has created a new overhang on its stock that Wall Street wasn't expecting when it established a new class of stock.

The Street's advice to Mark Zuckerberg and his team: Issue the stock fast so the focus can return to the clear product momentum the company is enjoying with its new Muse AI agent .

"The sooner the better in our view as it would remove the overhang and the Street now knows it will have non-voting shares in Jan'27, and Meta can still do a substantial equity raise before then without even coming close to impacting Mark's voting control," JPMorgan analyst Doug Anmuth said.

Meta announced late Wednesday that it is establishing a new class of nonvoting Class C common stock, which effectively serves as a 2-for-1 stock split.

Under the scheme — in part designed to keep founder Mark Zuckerberg working in California as the 5% billionaire's tax looms — existing shareholders will receive one new nonvoting Class C share for every Class A or Class B share they hold. Trading is slated to begin in January 2027.

Issuing nonvoting stock allows Zuckerberg to raise external capital for Meta's AI build-out without diluting his personal voting control over the tech giant.

The news took some air out of the balloon on what was an impressive quarter for Meta amid signs that its AI investments are paying off.

Meta's core advertising business reported a 26% increase in total revenue to $64.6 billion, powered by AI-driven recommendations, higher ad volume, and rising ad prices.

GAAP earnings per share came in at $3.83 versus analyst estimates of $3.56.

Meta stock fell 2% in premarket trading on Thursday.

"Net/net, some near-term noise in Meta shares, but we're encouraged by core Advertising and Meta's outlook for strong overall revenue growth in 2027, and the path to superintelligence is increasingly clear w/the Muse series of models & products," Anmuth said.

Brian Sozzi is Yahoo Finance's Executive Editor, host of the Sozzi Unleashed morning show and the Power Players with Brian Sozzi podcast, and a member of Yahoo Finance's editorial leadership team.

news.Title: 薔琵攪局 台積電運動會喊卡 10年內第4度停辦
news.Content:
受到薔琵颱風逼近與停班停課影響，晶圓代工龍頭台積電22日宣布，考量同仁與眷屬人身安全，原訂24日於新竹縣立體育場登場的「2026台積電運動會」確定取消辦理，這也是台積電自2023年全面恢復實體運動會以來，首度因天災因素停辦。

新竹縣市政府22日晚間宣布，受到強烈風雨威脅，23日全天停止上班上課，台積電隨即公告，因運動會各項事前準備工作受颱風停班影響，在兼顧活動籌辦進度與現場人員安全第一的前提下，決定取消本屆運動會相關活動。

台積電運動會向來是半導體產業年度重頭戲，除了高層對產業景氣發表關鍵風向球，創辦人張忠謀出席致詞與高額紅包獎金更是全場焦點。

盤點過去10年（2017年至2026年）台積電運動會舉辦歷程，在此之前僅在2020年至2022年連續3年因新冠肺炎（COVID-19）疫情衝擊、防範群聚風險而停辦；2023年恢復實體舉辦後，連續3年如期盛大舉行，本次則是近10年來第4次停辦、更是首次因颱風攪局而臨時喊卡。

雖然實體賽事因天候取消，但外界關注的基層特別紅包與員工福利發放措施，將持續關注是否比照過去疫情停辦模式直接入帳。

news.Title: TSX futures point lower following Meta, Tesla earnings
news.Content:
Investing.com - Futures linked to Canada's main stock index edged lower, as a surge in oil prices fueled concerns over energy-driven inflation, while worries swirled around the artificial intelligence trade following results from Meta Platforms.

Still guessing which stocks will beat the market? Our AI portfolio updates monthly and is outperforming the S&P 500 by 118%. See this month's list »

By 07:37 ET (11:37 GMT), the S&P/TSX 60 index standard futures contract had fallen by 13 points, or 0.6%.

On Wednesday, the S&P/TSX composite index finished higher by 0.6% at 36,324.99, notching its highest closing level since September 22.

Technology stocks advanced on strong quarterly results from SpaceX and Super Micro Computer, while a jump in Toronto-Dominion Bank powered a climb in heavily weighted financial stocks.

Meanwhile, Canada and the province of Ontario announced a new slate of measures aimed to buffer domestic steel and auto companies against the impact of U.S. tariffs.

U.S. futures slide

U.S. stock futures fell sharply, as investors parsed through earnings from Meta and Tesla. By 07:50 ET, the S&P 500 futures contract had fallen by 78 points, or 1.0%, Nasdaq 100 futures had dropped by 514 points, or 1.7%, and Dow futures had retreated by 298 points, or 0.6%.

The main averages on Wall Street advanced in the prior session, buoyed by strong results from Musk's rocket company SpaceX and server maker Super Micro Computer. The returns helped to assuage some recent concerns around the sustainability of the artificial intelligence trade, although analysts at Deutsche Bank flagged that the decline in Nasdaq futures could be a sign that not all investors were reassured.

Jitters have surrounded the AI sector for several days, triggered by a combination of heavy debt-fueled spending on AI infrastructure and elevated borrowing costs. Roller-coaster movements in AI-exposed stocks have mirrored shifting sentiment around AI, especially after fresh corporate returns appeared to indicate that demand for the nascent technology remains solid.

"When it comes to AI overall, it really does seem like the space has (permanently) entered a new era, one defined by less hospitable (or at the least more discerning) capital markets, which is why investors aren't as impressed as they were before by big headline spending numbers given the increased scrutiny on how the infrastructure will be paid for," analysts at Vital Knowledge said in a note.

The analysts also flagged worries that fighting between the U.S. and Iran could flare up once again in the coming weeks, possibly threatening oil supplies out of the Middle East in the process. Partially driving these fears was a New York Times report that the U.S. and Israel have drawn up plans for renewed strikes against Iran after the U.S. midterm elections in November, targeting Iran's energy infrastructure, nuclear facilities, and missile arsenal.

Story Continues

Against this backdrop, oil prices have marched higher. Benchmark Brent crude futures were last higher by 3.0% at $112.08 a barrel, while U.S. West Texas Intermediate crude futures had gained 2.3% to $99.45 a barrel.

Gold prices, in turn, sank to their lowest level in more than two weeks.

Unsure what to buy ahead of earnings? Our AI's recent pre-earnings calls delivered gains of +77% to +118% after results dropped. See this month's earnings picks »

While the Federal Reserve is tipped to skip an interest rate hike at its October 27-28 gathering, markets are betting that the central bank will lift borrowing costs at its final meeting of the year in December. Last month, the Fed raised rates for the first time since 2023, citing a desire to quell mounting inflationary pressures.

Higher rates can dent the appeal of gold by increasing the opportunity cost of holding the non-yielding asset.

Meta, Tesla earnings in focus

Meta unveiled higher-than-anticipated third-quarter revenue and announced plans to create a new class of nonvoting stock to raise capital for its AI ambitions. Shares of the Instagram-owner turned lower in premarket U.S. trading.

Along with resilience in its core advertising business, the well-received debut of Meta's Muse AI assistant in September has helped bolster returns during a time when the tech titan is investing hundreds of billions of dollars into the AI race. Hopes have been high that Muse will eventually add $28.5 billion of incremental revenue by 2030, according to Truist Securities projections cited by the Wall Street Journal.

CEO Mark Zuckerberg said in a post-earnings call that roughly a fourth of people who have set up Muse use it on "any given day," particularly for shopping. Zuckerberg added that Meta is aiming to create a "large-scale Muse network," even though the app has been blocked on some websites, such as Amazon.com.

For the current quarter, Meta guided for revenue of $73 billion to $76 billion, with the top end of the range exceeding Wall Street estimates. The firm also narrowed its capital expenditures forecast to $135 billion to $145 billion. The low end of the outlook was previously $130 billion.

Shares of Tesla also fell premarket, weighed down by the Elon Musk-led EV group reducing its goal for per-year sales by the end of the decade to 5 million units, while investors eyed the potential for a blockbuster tie-up with SpaceX.

Previously, Musk had guided for annual sales of 20 million vehicles. However, Musk has appeared to back away from this goal in recent years, focusing instead on pivoting Tesla's strategic focus to AI and robotics. Musk said the company is hoping to start shipping its Optimus humanoid robots to corporate customers by the end of 2027 and outlined plans for its autonomous taxis to become a major revenue source.

Cash flow was positive in the third quarter despite Tesla's big investments on AI and robotics. Still, Tesla predicted that it would end up spending around $20 billion in capital expenditures this year, compared to a prior estimate of $25 billion.

Quarterly revenue was flat, while net income dropped 4% to $1.7 billion.

Elsewhere on the earnings slate, American Airlines reported third-quarter results that exceeded analyst expectations but issued fourth-quarter guidance that fell short of estimates, sending shares down.

Lockheed Martin notched third-quarter results that surpassed estimates, as defense production accelerated across all business segments. Shares gained before the opening bell.

Spotify Technology premium subscribers grew by six million in the third quarter to 306 million, topping the audio streaming service's previous guidance and surpassing Wall Street estimates. Shares in the Swedish group advanced.

news.Title: Brokers Suggest Investing in Meta Platforms (META): Read This Before Placing a Bet
news.Content:
Investors often turn to recommendations made by Wall Street analysts before making a Buy, Sell, or Hold decision about a stock. While media reports about rating changes by these brokerage-firm employed (or sell-side) analysts often affect a stock's price, do they really matter?

Before we discuss the reliability of brokerage recommendations and how to use them to your advantage, let's see what these Wall Street heavyweights think about Meta Platforms (META).

Meta Platforms currently has an average brokerage recommendation (ABR) of 1.29, on a scale of 1 to 5 (Strong Buy to Strong Sell), calculated based on the actual recommendations (Buy, Hold, Sell, etc.) made by 56 brokerage firms. An ABR of 1.29 approximates between Strong Buy and Buy.

Of the 56 recommendations that derive the current ABR, 47 are Strong Buy and two are Buy. Strong Buy and Buy respectively account for 83.9% and 3.6% of all recommendations.

Brokerage Recommendation Trends for META

Check price target & stock forecast for Meta Platforms here>>>

The ABR suggests buying Meta Platforms, but making an investment decision solely on the basis of this information might not be a good idea. According to several studies, brokerage recommendations have little to no success guiding investors to choose stocks with the most potential for price appreciation.

Are you wondering why? The vested interest of brokerage firms in a stock they cover often results in a strong positive bias of their analysts in rating it. Our research shows that for every "Strong Sell" recommendation, brokerage firms assign five "Strong Buy" recommendations.

In other words, their interests aren't always aligned with retail investors, rarely indicating where the price of a stock could actually be heading. Therefore, the best use of this information could be validating your own research or an indicator that has proven to be highly successful in predicting a stock's price movement.

Zacks Rank, our proprietary stock rating tool with an impressive externally audited track record, categorizes stocks into five groups, ranging from Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) to Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell), and is an effective indicator of a stock's price performance in the near future. Therefore, using the ABR to validate the Zacks Rank could be an efficient way of making a profitable investment decision.

Zacks Rank Should Not Be Confused With ABR

Although both Zacks Rank and ABR are displayed in a range of 1--5, they are different measures altogether.

The ABR is calculated solely based on brokerage recommendations and is typically displayed with decimals (example: 1.28). In contrast, the Zacks Rank is a quantitative model allowing investors to harness the power of earnings estimate revisions. It is displayed in whole numbers -- 1 to 5.

Story Continues

Analysts employed by brokerage firms have been and continue to be overly optimistic with their recommendations. Since the ratings issued by these analysts are more favorable than their research would support because of the vested interest of their employers, they mislead investors far more often than they guide.

In contrast, the Zacks Rank is driven by earnings estimate revisions. And near-term stock price movements are strongly correlated with trends in earnings estimate revisions, according to empirical research.

In addition, the different Zacks Rank grades are applied proportionately to all stocks for which brokerage analysts provide current-year earnings estimates. In other words, this tool always maintains a balance among its five ranks.

There is also a key difference between the ABR and Zacks Rank when it comes to freshness. When you look at the ABR, it may not be up-to-date. Nonetheless, since brokerage analysts constantly revise their earnings estimates to reflect changing business trends, and their actions get reflected in the Zacks Rank quickly enough, it is always timely in predicting future stock prices.

Should You Invest in META?

In terms of earnings estimate revisions for Meta Platforms, the Zacks Consensus Estimate for the current year has declined 7% over the past month to $29.94.

Analysts' growing pessimism over the company's earnings prospects, as indicated by strong agreement among them in revising EPS estimates lower, could be a legitimate reason for the stock to plunge in the near term.

The size of the recent change in the consensus estimate, along with three other factors related to earnings estimates, has resulted in a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) for Meta Platforms. You can see the complete list of today's Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) stocks here >>>>

Therefore, it could be wise to take the Buy-equivalent ABR for Meta Platforms with a grain of salt.

news.Title: 路透：台積電尋求使用無稀土馬達 擺脫中國稀土壟斷控制
news.Content:
三名知情人士透露，台積電( 2330-TW ) ( TSM-US ) 正在尋求工廠設備中稀土元件的替代方案，以降低北京當局出口管制對其生產全球最先進晶片工廠運作的干擾。

據《路透》22日（周四）報導，這項首次被報導的舉動，凸顯出在中國去年將特定稀土原料、磁鐵及相關加工技術納入出口管制並要求取得許可後，中國對稀土的控制已成為全球半導體產業隱憂。

稀土磁鐵常用於工業設備馬達，包括台積電等高度自動化工廠使用的機械設備。此類專業零件短缺，可能會中斷智慧型手機、人工智慧（AI）系統、資料中心和國防供應鏈客戶的晶片生產。

據三位聽取台積電計畫簡報的產業高階主管表示，台積電已經向供應商徵詢在工廠自動化設備中使用無稀土馬達事宜。其中一位知情人士表示，此項行動源於中國可能停止供應的擔憂。

其中兩位消息人士透露，相關討論仍處於初步階段，尚未大規模推廣使用無稀土設備。

台積電對此不予置評。

台積電採取行動之前，美國與我國政府相繼表示，將開始尋找減少對中國稀土和關鍵礦物供應鏈依賴的方法。

台灣經濟部長龔明鑫曾在2月說，將支援國內研究機構工研院開發稀土技術，計劃在三年內建立一條試產生產線，估計可滿足國內50%需求。

據一位了解相關討論的美國智庫人士透露，美國官員對工研院的研究工作很感興趣，已與工研院就關鍵礦物供應鏈分散展開討論。美國國務院未立即回應置評請求。

news.Title: History Says This Will Happen to Sandisk Stock Heading Into Its Oct. 29 Report
news.Content:
Sandisk (NASDAQ: SNDK) has been one of the hottest stocks of the year. Its memory products are in high demand for artificial intelligence (AI) data centers, and thanks to a shortage of those products, it's achieving extraordinary revenue and profit growth. As a result, the stock is up 478% so far in 2026.

The memory giant will report results for its fiscal 2027 first quarter on Oct. 29. Here's what history suggests might happen before it does.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Low supply for AI

As the artificial intelligence (AI) trend has progressed, the focus has shifted repeatedly. First, much of the interest was on the foundational models; then came demand for data centers and the AI accelerators and GPUs that provided compute for those models. There has been a concurrent boost to the energy sector as the tech players had to answer the question of where the electricity to power all of those new data centers was going to come from.

Now, getting enough memory for those data centers has become one of the most critical parts of the infrastructure build-out process.

Sandisk makes many kinds of memory products, from the memory cards in your smartphone to the dynamic random access memory (DRAM) in your laptop, but the recent frenzy is for its NAND flash memory, which can keep storing data even when it's not powered on, and is vital for AI training. Sandisk is one of the few makers of NAND, and data centers have become a huge part of Sandisk's business.

Scarcity is what's driving this rally -- demand from data centers far exceeds the supply of NAND that Sandisk and its peers can manufacture, so they've all been able to boost prices sharply, and all are experiencing rapid growth.

In Sandisk's fiscal 2026 fourth quarter (which ended July 3), revenue increased 372% year over year, and data center revenue doubled just from its fiscal Q3.

Is this the end of the cycle?

Despite its massive growth and soaring profits -- it booked $43.97 in earnings per share in its fiscal fourth quarter -- Sandisk stock is rather cheap, trading at a P/E ratio of under 19. That lack of a premium is tied to investors' worries that the end of this up phase of the memory cycle is inevitable.

Historically, memory companies have always gone through booms and busts based on the supply-and-demand cycle. When supplies are tight, prices rise, and manufacturers build new foundries to expand capacity. Then supply catches up to and exceeds demand (which often declines cyclically as well), and prices tumble again.

Story Continues

Right now, the AI build-out requires huge quantities of memory products, but data center construction and processor purchases are likely to taper off at some point. The question is when.

Anticipating this, Sandisk this year introduced its new business model (NBM) agreements, which lock in long-term sales deals with large customers, guaranteeing some price floors and purchase volumes for multiple years. It had eight NMBs as of the end of the fiscal fourth quarter. Management notes that it provides necessary infrastructure components to the biggest and most important tech companies, and those businesses are planning -- and purchasing -- several years in advance. It's also focusing on its highest-value products and markets, which management believes will lead to "more durable earnings power."

What might happen before Oct. 29

Western Digital spun off Sandisk in February 2025, and since its return to the market as an independent company, the stock has climbed prior to all previous earnings reports except the most recent one. By then, Sandisk stock had soared to an expensive level. It has started to rise again, but it's still not back to its previous high. So while history suggests it's going to climb again over the next few days, the trend has changed.

SNDK data by YCharts

Since the stock price is much lower today, there's room for it to rise in the coming days, and to keep heading higher after earnings if it meets or surpasses expectations. Management is guiding for $10.5 billion in revenue at the midpoint, a 357% increase over last year, and $45 in EPS. Wall Street is expecting a 363% increase and $46.27 in EPS. The market will also be looking for new business deals and guidance for continued high growth.

news.Content:
護國神山台積電（2330）預計10月24日舉行年度運動會，但卻碰上強颱薔琵，運動會取消。

台積電表示，受薔琵颱風影響，新竹縣市政府公告10/23 （五）停止上班，原訂於10/24 (六) 舉行之台積電運動會的準備工作也受到影響，考量人員安全，2026 台積電運動會將取消辦理。

每年台積電運動會都是市場焦點。回顧去年，輝達（NVIDIA）執行長黃仁勳特別到場挺台積電，創辦人張忠謀因為身體不適沒有出席，今年創辦人張忠謀是否出席原是外界矚目的關鍵。

更重要的是員工最期待的「神山紅包」，去年董事長魏哲家發給基層與中階台灣員工每人 2.5 萬元的特別獎金，並霸氣宣告會「一年比一年高」，今年在營運續旺下，原本各界相當期待發放金額能否再衝高，如今活動因颱風喊卡，也讓今年的獎金留待後續揭曉。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

news.Title: Ford Plans to Overtake Toyota in a Critical Business. Here's Why It Matters.
news.Content:
About a year ago, Ford Motor Company (NYSE: F) made an intriguing move by partnering with online retailer juggernaut Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN) that many investors overlooked. That was when Ford announced it would sell Ford Blue Advantage vehicles, or certified pre-owned (CPO) vehicles, on Amazon Autos.

Let's peel back the outer layers of this move, which has helped boost Ford's CPO sales by 44% during the third quarter and surpassed Toyota 's (NYSE: TM) volume for the first time. Here's exactly why Ford's expanding CPO sales is a great thing for long-term investors .

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Pedal to the metal

Ford is well on its way to topping its 500,000 CPO sales target for 2027, which will likely remove Toyota from its spot as the industry's top certified seller. Better still, Ford's impressive 44% gain in CPO sales during Q3 comes with the industry's CPO sales declining 2.5% through August, according to Automotive News Data Center. This is all great news, but let's explain exactly how and why this is great news for long-term investors.

Ford launched its dealer-led CPO program, Ford Blue Advantage, in 2021. About 70% of Ford's 2,800 U.S. dealerships participate in the program, which also launched a similar program for Ford Pro commercial vehicles. What's interesting about Ford's CPO business is that when consumers buy a non-certified used vehicle, they return to the manufacturer only about 30% of the time. When that sale is for a certified vehicle, the consumer remains loyal and returns to the brand more than half the time.

"The biggest part that I press on our dealers of why it's important to certify the vehicles is that connectivity back to the brand," according to Rob Kaffl, Ford's director of U.S. sales and dealer relations. "You have an audience that we can now market to moving forward for a new vehicle or any of our other services."

Why CPO sales are important

Another big part of the CPO business for Ford is that after discontinuing the Escape and Lincoln Corsair last year, it has fewer entry-level options for consumers. CPO sales help the Detroit automaker fill this void for budget-conscious buyers and gives Ford another way for its dealers to retain and attract consumers.

CPO sales can also move the needle for Ford's overall sales, as it has started giving dealers certificates for each sale through its Ford Blue Advantage program, which effectively serves as an incentive to help lower new-vehicle prices. Ford's CPO sales have grown 96% since beginning in 2021 and are on pace to double its first six months of 2026 CPO sales during the second half of the year.

Story Continues

Investors shouldn't underestimate the importance of Ford's expanding CPO program because consumer loyalty in the automotive industry is incredibly powerful and "conquesting" consumers from a rival brand can be costly. Increasing loyalty, filling the void of entry-level options, and creating a new car sales pipeline through dealer certificates and incentives can move the needle for new vehicle purchases. All in all, if Ford executes and indeed surpasses Toyota in CPO sales next year, it's just one more reason to believe Ford is still turning into a well-rounded business for long-term investors.

news.Title: 台股9月高檔震盪　全體券商獲利187億元月減3成
news.Content:

證交所分析，今年前9月證券商經紀手續費收入因大盤總成交值增加而較去年同期成長，全體證券商前9月經紀業務獲利1624.60億元，年成長140.47%；同時間，全體證券商自營業務獲利696.48億元，比去年同期大幅成長289.07%；承銷業務獲利188.16億元，年增178.01%；3大業務前9月獲利都較去年呈現三位數成長。

news.Title: 台股震盪「瑤池金母」連5天砸117億再掃7檔AI股：這檔買到只輸台積電
news.Content: 台股今（22）日重挫846.34點，收在46,041.43點，跌幅1.81%，高檔震盪讓市場關注資金動向。被封為 「瑤池金母」 的統一投信基金經理人 陳釧瑤， 操盤的主動式ETF統一台股增長 （00981A） 卻持續加碼AI供應鏈。 財經專家《籌碼小哥葛》 指出，00981A截至昨（21）日已連續5個交易日「只買不賣」，累計買超金額約117億元，更於21日大盤反彈594點時，再次掃貨7檔AI大軍，展現強烈多頭意圖。其中欣銓（3264）獲買超5.75億元最多，欣興（3037）則升至第二大持股，僅次於台積電（2330）。 【00981A連5天只買不賣！累計加碼約117億元】 《籌碼小哥葛》在臉書發文分析，台股21日反彈594.84點，收在46,887點，但法人並未全面大舉回補，三大法人合計僅小幅買超約5.7億元。在市場震盪之際，00981A的操作方向格外受到關注。 他觀察，00981A近期操作呈現 「指數回檔就買、高檔反而調節」 的特徵，並非單純追逐股價上漲，而是趁市場震盪逐步增加看好的持股。截至21日，00981A已連續5個交易日「零賣出」沒有賣出股票，期間累計買超約117億元。即使21日台股反彈，基金仍持續加碼，顯示其資金配置依舊偏向看好的產業主線。 【瑤池金母再掃7檔！欣銓獲買超5.75億元居冠】 根據00981A於10月21日的持股異動資料，當天共加碼7檔個股，沒有新增或減碼其他持股。依買超金額排序如下： 1.欣銓（3264）：買進2,170張，約5.75億元。 2.奇鋐（3017）：買進114張，約3.69億元。 3.緯創（3231）：買進1,300張，約2.54億元。 4.富世達（6805）：買進100張，約2.40億元。 5.欣興（3037）：買進190張，約2.09億元。 6.智邦（2345）：買進67張，約1.22億元。 7.京元電子（2449）：買進236張，約0.66億元。 7檔個股合計買超金額約18.35億元，涵蓋半導體測試、AI伺服器、散熱、網通及PCB載板等領域。從持股異動來看，00981A並未因短線震盪轉向防禦型配置，而是繼續加碼AI與半導體相關供應鏈。 其中，緯創（3231）繼前一日剛建倉後，21日再加碼1,300張，以當日收盤價195元估算，買進金額約2.54億元，呈現連續兩個交易日加碼的情況。

news.Title: 凍資台股8千億「吸金怪獸」漢測上櫃一個月就庫藏股自救！明起買回自家股票30萬股
news.Content:
庫藏股自救！有「吸金怪獸」之稱的半導體廠漢測（7856）一度凍資台股8千多億元，還創下新股抽中一張賺245萬元紀錄，如今上櫃才一個月就需要「護盤」。股價從9月中5445元天價跌到剩3410元，等於一張帳面蒸發203萬元，一台豪華轎車沒了，跌幅高達37%，今（22）日公司宣布實施庫藏股自救兼護盤，自明天（23日）起至12月22日買回自家公司股票300張，目的是轉讓給員工。

漢測經董事會決議明天開始實施庫藏股，日期為10/23~12/22日以上限15億4499萬元，自集中市場買回30萬股（等於300張）股票。買回區間價格為3,700.00~4,300元，以12.9億元作為買回股份之總金額上限，買回本公司普通股，預定買回股數為300,000股。

等於買回300張，作為激勵員工及提昇員工向心力，自買回股份之日起5年內，一次或分次轉讓予員工，以實際買回之平均價格為轉讓價格。

同時漢測今日董事會亦通過「中南部建置製造中心」預算授權案。預計投資廠房新台幣37億元及設備12億元，用於(1)矽光子設備組裝；(2)MEMS探針卡製造產線；(3)回焊設備製造產線；(4)薄膜探針卡產能擴充及(5)雷射清針機製造產線。

此外，公司也通過決議通過「新竹研發中心建置」預算授權案，以新臺幣15億元上限，興建廠辦及裝修。

漢測於9月22日以每股2,250元掛牌上櫃，當時創下今年最高IPO承銷價紀錄，同時凍資市場8656億元的熱門超級紅包，創下抽中一張賺245萬元的紀錄。

葉憶如／財經特派記者組長，主跑金管會、金控壽險、航空等

news.Title: 外資再砍台股逾800億　新台幣貶2分收32.508元
news.Content:
（中央社記者潘姿羽台北2026年10月22日電）市場AI疑慮未消，加上連假前賣壓湧現，外資今天再揮刀大砍台股逾800億元，股匯同步下挫，新台幣兌美元收盤收32.508元，小貶2分，台北及元太外匯市場總成交金額為35.71億美元。

儘管美股21日主要指數全面收紅，費城半導體指數上漲1.97%，台股今天在連假前賣壓提前湧現下，指數開高震盪翻黑，上下震盪達1290點，終場下跌846.34點，收在全天最低點46041.43點。

外資昨天回補台股曇花一現，今天再度轉為賣超，且大砍台股816.56億元。

外匯交易員直言，受到颱風可能導致台灣股匯市休市的預期影響，外資提前撤出資金、降低風險部位，使新台幣再度承受貶值壓力。新台幣兌美元今天以32.47元開盤後，上午震盪偏弱，午後隨著外資加大匯出力道，貶幅迅速擴大，最低觸及32.642元，出口商隨即進場拋匯，提供支撐，加上央行調節，終場貶幅收斂至2分。

外匯交易員指出，美元指數稍有回落，減輕亞幣貶值壓力，不過外資動向仍是牽動新台幣匯率的關鍵。由於市場對AI產業的疑慮尚未消散，一旦指標企業財報不如預期，或其他金融風險升溫，外資不排除再度擴大匯出。

展望後市，外匯交易員認為，若接下來幾個交易日台股逐步回穩，外資也未再大規模匯出，新台幣可望回到32.2至32.6元區間盤整，下一個觀察重點則是美國聯準會10月底利率決策會議釋出的政策訊號。

news.Title: If I Could Only Buy 1 Artificial Intelligence (AI) Semiconductor Stock to Buy Before 2027, It Would Be This One
news.Content:
Last week was the worst stretch for chip stocks in over a year. The Philadelphia Semiconductor index dropped more than 11%, a hot inflation print raised the cost of funding every data center on the drawing board, and the impact of worries about CoreWeave 's (NASDAQ: CRWV) debt load spread to every company selling into AI infrastructure.

Marvell Technology (NASDAQ: MRVL) sank by nearly 17% in five days. And yet, if your goal is to own one AI chip stock heading into 2027, that decline is the reason why you should look into picking up shares of Marvell now rather than later. Even as investors were selling, the company spent the week revealing its most specific, product-level work of the year, and almost nobody noticed because they were watching the tape.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

What Marvell announced while its stock was falling

Marvell is not a GPU company. It designs chips that sit around GPUs: the custom accelerators that hyperscalers and AI labs are building for their specific workloads, the optical and copper links that connect thousands of processors into clusters, and the memory controllers that keep those chips fed with data. That is the business the company put on display at the Open Compute Project Global Summit in San Jose from Oct. 12 to Oct. 15.

Two announcements from the event stood out to me. On Oct. 12, Marvell unveiled the second generation of its Structera X memory expanders -- chips built to attack what the company calls the "memory wall" in AI inference. The problem is simple: As models get bigger and context windows get longer, GPUs run out of memory before they run out of math. Structera X lets a server bolt on up to 6 terabytes of standard DDR5 memory, share it across four hosts, and compress it on the fly, which the company says cuts time to first token by 40% to 50%. The first generation Structera X is already shipping to hyperscalers, and a Meta Platforms (NASDAQ: META) hardware engineering director was quoted in the company's release. Test models of the second generation will be available in Q1 2027.

Then, on Oct. 13, Marvell followed by unveiling two 3-nanometer connectivity chips, a 3.2-terabit retimer and a new active electrical cable chip that doubles copper reach to more than six meters between AI servers and switches. Both support UALink, the open standard that non-Nvidia accelerators use to talk to each other. Early samples of both are already available for potential customers.

Story Continues

That sounds like a lot of jargon, so here is the plain version. An AI processor's usefulness will always be limited by the memory it can reach and the capacity of the connections that link it to neighboring chips. The new products Marvell announced last week address both of those bottlenecks: one lets a server strap on far more memory than the GPU came with, so it can handle bigger models without choking, and the other helps racks of accelerators talk to each other over longer, cheaper copper cables without the signal falling apart. These are tools crucial for AI infrastructure, and Marvell is selling them.

Some numbers to consider

On Oct. 6 -- a week before the AI sector rout -- Marvell held its first investor day in years, and management used the event to publicize a target worth reading twice: It's aiming for revenue in the range of $70 billion to $90 billion by its fiscal 2031, up from $8.2 billion in fiscal 2026, with implied non-GAAP earnings above $30 per share . The engine driving it toward those targets is what management calls "XPU attach," the networking, memory, and security chips that get pulled along with every custom accelerator a cloud provider designs.

Big targets deserve some skepticism, and this one assumes 55% to 60% annualized growth for five years. But even if it achieves growth at half that rate, the stock near $228 is cheap against what the company expects to earn. Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA) saw enough to buy $2 billion of Marvell preferred stock in March, and Nvidia does not make such investments casually.

Other things to consider: Marvell trades at a high trailing earnings ratio; custom chip revenue is lumpy and tied to a few customers; and if hyperscalers pull back due to higher borrowing costs, Marvell will feel the pain before Nvidia does. But last week's sell-off was driven by financing fears, not by any customers walking away, and Marvell kept shipping through it. For anyone able to buy this stock and hold onto it through 2027 or longer, the 17% discount the market just gave it makes it look like a steal.

news.Title: Not Micron. Not Sandisk. This Storage Stock Is Riding the Same AI Infrastructure Wave.
news.Content:
When it comes to artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure stocks, Micron Technology and Sandisk have been getting plenty of attention this year. Both are benefiting from the massive demand for memory and storage driven by the global expansion of AI data centers.

While Micron manufactures memory chips and Sandisk specializes in flash storage, Western Digital (NASDAQ: WDC) makes the high-capacity hard disk drives (HDDs) that cloud computing companies use to store enormous amounts of information.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

It's a different part of the AI infrastructure business but one that's becoming increasingly important as companies build more powerful AI systems. And that's why I think Western Digital deserves a closer look. The stock is up more than 100% so far this year, with plenty more room to run.

AI needs more than powerful processors

Companies like Nvidia , Broadcom , and Advanced Micro Devices get a lot of attention surrounding AI infrastructure because they make powerful processors essential to allowing AI models to process information quickly.

But what happens to all that information after it's processed?

AI companies need somewhere to store training data sets, model outputs, historical records, and the enormous amounts of new information their systems generate. And keeping everything on expensive, high-performance flash storage isn't necessarily practical.

Western Digital's HDDs are important because traditional hard drives -- while slower than solid-state drives (SSDs) -- can store large amounts of information at a lower cost.

A Western Digital customer survey released in May found that 87% of respondents prioritized expanding storage capacity and reducing total ownership costs. Among respondents who knew their storage mix, 70% reported that hard drives accounted for more than half of their storage capacity.

That helps explain why HDDs aren't becoming obsolete as AI expands. They're serving a different purpose.

Western Digital is expanding its storage capabilities

Western Digital is also developing new technology to make its drives more attractive to cloud computing companies.

In February, the company announced a roadmap that includes hard drives capable of storing more than 100 terabytes of information. It also introduced a 40-terabyte drive that's undergoing customer qualification. (A terabyte is about 1,000 gigabytes.)

Story Continues

Demand for additional storage doesn't appear to be slowing. A September IDC study sponsored by Western Digital found that 61% of surveyed organizations experienced at least 25% data growth over the previous year due to AI. Nearly three-quarters expected similar growth over the next three years.

Western Digital stock at a glance

Shares of Western Digital are up 105% so far this year -- not as much as Sandisk and Micron but still much better than the broader index.

Revenue for the company's fiscal fourth quarter (ending July 3) was $3.75 billion, up 44% from a year ago and 12% from Q3. The company continued to improve its margins, which increased from 41% to 54.1% over the last year, and generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) net income was $3.19 billion, a whopping 1,215% increase from a year ago. Notably, much of that increase was attributable to Western Digital's interest in Sandisk, which the company spun off in 2025. Western Digital recorded a $2.05 billion gain from Sandisk. Adjusted net income, which is more representative of the company's hard-drive business, was $1.38 billion, up 130% from a year ago.

For the full fiscal year, Western Digital had revenue of $12.92 billion, up 36% from fiscal 2025, and adjusted earnings of $3.88 billion, up 120% from the previous year.

Why I like Western Digital right now

I love AI infrastructure stocks because you can invest in the industry's expansion without having to predict which AI platform will eventually dominate the market.

Whether companies are training new AI models, operating cloud computing platforms, or deploying AI applications for their customers, they're generating information that needs to be stored. And Western Digital is building the high-capacity drives that can handle much of that demand at a relatively low cost.

I don't see the demand for data storage from AI disappearing anytime soon. Micron and Sandisk have demonstrated just how attractive the memory and storage markets can be for investors. Western Digital is participating in that same infrastructure expansion even if its products don't get the same attention.

For investors seeking another way to participate in the growth of AI infrastructure, I think Western Digital makes a compelling case.

news.Title: Chip stocks shrug off a scary morning, but history says the shakeout isn't over
news.Content:
Wall Street's AI darlings were in free fall at the open. By midmorning, they were leading the comeback.

The PHLX Semiconductor Index ( ^SOX ) sank to its lowest level since early August early Tuesday. It was supposed to be the moment Monday's relief rally fell apart after an eight-session losing streak.

Instead, buyers stormed in. The index is now higher on the day and back above Friday's close, springing a bear trap much like the one forming in CoreWeave ( CRWV ).

The rebound is broad too. Roughly 3 of every 4 stocks in a 60-stock Yahoo Finance chip basket have turned green, including heavyweights AMD ( AMD ), Taiwan Semiconductor ( TSM ), Intel ( INTC ), and Micron ( MU ). GlobalFoundries ( GFS ) tops the list.

Notice who's missing from the party. Chip equipment makers Lam Research ( LRCX ), KLA ( KLAC ), and Applied Materials ( AMAT ) are still in the red, along with Arm ( ARM ). Even Nvidia ( NVDA ), the AI trade's bellwether, is barely keeping up.

Buyers are picking their spots, favoring the companies that make chips over the ones that sell them the tools.

History says the real test may still be ahead

The track record says don't count on the bottom being in just yet.

After every losing streak of seven sessions or more since 1994, the index traded below the streak's final close within a month, according to Yahoo Finance calculations. After the longest streaks, it was lower a month later most of the time.

And those dips weren't shallow. The typical one after the longest streaks ran about 9%. Tuesday's barely scratched 1% before buyers pounced.

One-day comebacks like this one haven't settled the question either. They've been a coin flip for chips.

The bulls do get a consolation prize. Three months out, the index was usually higher.

BofA Global Research called last week's rout a "positioning-driven hiccup on the fringes of the AI trade" in a research report. If that's right, the bounce has room to run. If not, the next dip is the one to watch.

For the index, it starts with the summer floor around 11,000 to 11,140, built from lows in late July and September, plus Friday's close. Holding it keeps Tuesday's comeback intact.

Lose it, and the next stop is the 10,450 to 10,500 zone, where chips bottomed in late July and traded in late April.

On the upside, bulls first need to clear 12,600 to 12,700, which capped the index in early October. Above that sits the early-October peak zone near 13,200 to 13,350.

Watch whether Tuesday's low holds and that big 11,000 level just underneath. That's where the silicon meets the road.

news.Title: 3 AI Stocks to Buy Amid This Deep Correction
news.Content:
The past few weeks have been tough for many artificial intelligence (AI) investors. A hot inflation report, AI financing concerns, and Chinese memory chips are some of the headwinds that have stalled the rally.

However, a few bad weeks don't justify exiting positions. In fact, these are the exact times when contrarian investors load up on positions and get greedy when others are fearful.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

These three AI stocks below have endured steep price cuts even though their fundamentals continue to improve.

1. Sandisk

This memory chipmaker is down by roughly 30% in less than one month, showing that the AI correction is even hitting big-name companies. Perhaps the narrative will shift when Sandisk (NASDAQ: SNDK) reports earnings on Oct. 29, but there is already plenty to like about the stock.

Sandisk produces NAND flash memory products that are critical as AI models, agents, and inference require vast amounts of memory capacity. Without sufficient memory, these products stop working or experience significant drops in quality.

People have become accustomed to AI models like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Grok handling their questions and providing actionable information in ways that a basic search can't. All of the data centers powering AI tools need NAND flash products, like the ones Sandisk offers.

While Sandisk isn't the only NAND flash memory provider, it's certainly the industry leader. That explains why Sandisk more than quadrupled its revenue year over year and authorized an additional $14 billion for stock buybacks. The dip comes at a good time for Sandisk's buyback program and for investors focused more on where the company is heading in five years than on what has happened to its stock price over the past month.

2. Nebius

High-volatility growth stocks usually get hit the hardest during these types of corrections, so it's no surprise that Nebius (NASDAQ: NBIS) has taken a beating over the past month. It has dropped by more than 30% in approximately two weeks despite parabolic demand for AI compute.

Nebius' Q2 shareholder letter explained that the company can sell out all of its 2027 capacity right now but is intentionally waiting it out because megawatt values keep climbing. Long-term contracts are now yielding $20 million to $25 million per megawatt each year, but Nebius is also signing short-term deals in the $40 million to $50 million per megawatt range.

Story Continues

The neocloud provider is also getting its customers to foot most of the bill for data center construction. Approximately 70% of deals come with prepayments, and those funds cover 50% to 60% of associated capital expenditures. Nebius can fill in the gap with GPU financing, bonds, and using its completed data centers as collateral.

Nebius and other neoclouds have slumped more than most AI stocks, as CoreWeave 's bond yields have reached 15%. However, this is a CoreWeave problem that is being misinterpreted as a neocloud problem. That should become clearer when Nebius reports earnings in November.

3. Comfort Systems USA

Comfort Systems USA (NYSE: FIX) hasn't been as bruised as the other two stocks on this list, but it's still down by more than 20% in less than two weeks. The company specializes in HVAC, electrical, and plumbing for large facilities. That puts it nicely at the intersection of the AI boom, which contributed to the company's 51% year-over-year revenue growth in the second quarter.

The company's Q2 revenue reached $3.27 billion compared with a backlog of $14.06 billion. As more data centers are built, revenue should continue to increase. Those same data centers will also need regular maintenance, which opens up long-term revenue streams for the company.

Comfort Systems USA uses an acquisition strategy to gain market share rapidly and make it more difficult for competitors to catch up. It consists of more than 50 companies spread across 184 locations in the United States. That growth also comes with solid finances. Comfort Systems USA managed to boost its dividend by 12.5% this year thanks to surging profits.
